CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.resolve_organization_zalo_entitlement_pools(p_organization_id bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(account_subtype text, entitlement_id bigint, product_id bigint, product_name text, package_name text, package_type text, expiration_date timestamp with time zone, max_sends_per_day integer, max_accounts integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, pool_revision text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
  WITH active_entitlements AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      entitlement.id,
      entitlement.product_id,
      entitlement.product_name,
      entitlement.package_name,
      entitlement.package_type,
      entitlement.expiration_date,
      entitlement.max_accounts,
      entitlement.created_at,
      entitlement.xmin::text AS entitlement_xmin,
      COALESCE(entitlement.is_zalo_show_web, false) AS grants_web,
      COALESCE(entitlement.is_zalo_server, false) AS grants_server,
      CASE
        WHEN entitlement.max_sends_per_day > 0 THEN entitlement.max_sends_per_day
        WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(entitlement.package_type, ''))) = 'demo' THEN 30
        ELSE NULL
      END AS resolved_daily_limit
    FROM public.org_organization_product AS entitlement
    WHERE entitlement.organization_id = p_organization_id
      AND entitlement.product_id IN (16, 18)
      AND entitlement.is_deleted = false
      AND entitlement.expiration_date IS NOT NULL
      AND entitlement.expiration_date >= (
        date_trunc('day', timezone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', now()))
          AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
      )
  ),
  representative AS (
    SELECT entitlement.*
    FROM active_entitlements AS entitlement
    ORDER BY
      entitlement.expiration_date DESC,
      entitlement.created_at DESC NULLS LAST,
      entitlement.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  merged AS (
    SELECT
      count(*) AS entitlement_count,
      count(*) > 0 AS qr_enabled,
      COALESCE(bool_or(entitlement.grants_web), false) AS web_enabled,
      COALESCE(bool_or(entitlement.grants_server), false) AS server_enabled,
      CASE
        WHEN count(*) = 0
          OR bool_or(entitlement.resolved_daily_limit IS NULL)
          THEN NULL
        ELSE max(entitlement.resolved_daily_limit)
      END AS max_sends_per_day,
      CASE
        WHEN count(*) = 0
          OR bool_or(
            entitlement.max_accounts IS NULL
              OR entitlement.max_accounts <= 0
          )
          THEN NULL
        ELSE max(entitlement.max_accounts)
      END AS max_accounts,
      md5(COALESCE(
        string_agg(
          entitlement.id::text || ':' || entitlement.entitlement_xmin,
          ',' ORDER BY entitlement.id
        ),
        ''
      )) AS aggregate_revision
    FROM active_entitlements AS entitlement
  ),
  slots(account_subtype, sort_order) AS (
    VALUES
      ('qr'::text, 1),
      ('web'::text, 2),
      ('server'::text, 3)
  )
  SELECT
    slot.account_subtype,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.id END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.product_id END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.product_name END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.package_name END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.package_type END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.expiration_date END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN merged.max_sends_per_day END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN merged.max_accounts END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.created_at END,
    CASE
      WHEN grant_state.enabled AND merged.entitlement_count = 1 THEN
        representative.id::text || ':' || representative.entitlement_xmin
      WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN
        representative.id::text || ':' || merged.aggregate_revision
      ELSE
        'none:'
          || COALESCE(p_organization_id::text, 'null')
          || ':'
          || slot.account_subtype
    END AS pool_revision
  FROM slots AS slot
  CROSS JOIN merged
  LEFT JOIN representative ON true
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE slot.account_subtype
      WHEN 'qr' THEN merged.qr_enabled
      WHEN 'web' THEN merged.web_enabled
      WHEN 'server' THEN merged.server_enabled
      ELSE false
    END AS enabled
  ) AS grant_state
  ORDER BY slot.sort_order;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.refresh_aka_customer_lifecycle_projections(p_customer_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_customer_id bigint;
begin
  for v_customer_id in
    select distinct candidate.customer_id
    from pg_catalog.unnest(coalesce(p_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[]))
      as candidate(customer_id)
    where candidate.customer_id is not null
    order by candidate.customer_id
  loop
    perform private.refresh_aka_customer_lifecycle_projection(v_customer_id);
  end loop;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.invalidate_aka_customer_lifecycle_source(p_source_table text, p_source_row_id bigint)
 RETURNS bigint[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_customer_ids bigint[];
begin
  select coalesce(
    pg_catalog.array_agg(distinct event_row.customer_id),
    '{}'::bigint[]
  )
  into v_customer_ids
  from public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event as event_row
  where event_row.source_table = p_source_table
    and event_row.source_row_id = p_source_row_id
    and event_row.invalidated_at is null;

  update public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event as event_row
  set invalidated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  where event_row.source_table = p_source_table
    and event_row.source_row_id = p_source_row_id
    and event_row.invalidated_at is null;

  return v_customer_ids;
end
$function$

  select

      array[

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.lifecycle_staff_quality(p_resolved_org_staff_id bigint, p_org_staff_id bigint, p_sql_staff_id bigint, p_chat_staff_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_resolved_org_staff_id is null then 'unknown'
    when p_org_staff_id is not null
      and p_resolved_org_staff_id = p_org_staff_id then 'direct'
    when exists (
      select 1
      from public.org_staff as staff
      where staff.id = p_resolved_org_staff_id
        and staff.sql_staff_id = p_sql_staff_id

    when exists (
      select 1
      from public.org_staff as staff
      where staff.id = p_resolved_org_staff_id
        and staff.chat_staff_id = p_chat_staff_id
    ) then 'mapped_chat'
    else 'unknown'
  end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.refresh_aka_customer_lifecycle_projection(p_customer_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_first_interest_at timestamptz;
  v_last_interest_at timestamptz;
  v_first_interest_staff_id bigint;
  v_last_interest_staff_id bigint;
  v_first_demo_at timestamptz;
  v_last_demo_at timestamptz;
  v_first_demo_staff_id bigint;
  v_last_demo_staff_id bigint;
  v_first_negotiation_at timestamptz;
  v_last_negotiation_at timestamptz;
  v_first_negotiation_staff_id bigint;
  v_last_negotiation_staff_id bigint;
  v_first_sale_at timestamptz;
  v_last_sale_at timestamptz;
  v_first_sale_staff_id bigint;
  v_last_sale_staff_id bigint;
  v_previous_projection_setting text;
begin
  if p_customer_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  perform customer.id
  from public.aka_customer as customer
  where customer.id = p_customer_id
  for update of customer;

  if not found then
    return;
  end if;

  with ranked as (
    select
      event_row.*,
      pg_catalog.row_number() over (
        partition by event_row.event_type
        order by
          event_row.event_at,
          (event_row.org_staff_id is null),
          case event_row.date_quality
            when 'exact' then 0
            when 'inferred' then 1
            else 2
          end,
          event_row.source_priority,
          event_row.source_changed_at,
          event_row.id
      ) as first_rank,
      pg_catalog.row_number() over (
        partition by event_row.event_type
        order by
          event_row.event_at desc,
          (event_row.org_staff_id is null),
          case event_row.date_quality
            when 'exact' then 0
            when 'inferred' then 1
            else 2
          end,
          event_row.source_priority,
          event_row.source_changed_at desc,
          event_row.id desc
      ) as last_rank
    from public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event as event_row
    where event_row.customer_id = p_customer_id
      and event_row.invalidated_at is null
  )
  select
    max(event_at) filter (where event_type = 'interest' and first_rank = 1),
    max(event_at) filter (where event_type = 'interest' and last_rank = 1),
    max(org_staff_id) filter (where event_type = 'interest' and first_rank = 1),
    max(org_staff_id) filter (where event_type = 'interest' and last_rank = 1),
    max(event_at) filter (where event_type = 'demo' and first_rank = 1),
    max(event_at) filter (where event_type = 'demo' and last_rank = 1),
    max(org_staff_id) filter (where event_type = 'demo' and first_rank = 1),
    max(org_staff_id) filter (where event_type = 'demo' and last_rank = 1),
    max(event_at) filter (where event_type = 'negotiation' and first_rank = 1),
    max(event_at) filter (where event_type = 'negotiation' and last_rank = 1),
    max(org_staff_id) filter (where event_type = 'negotiation' and first_rank = 1),
    max(org_staff_id) filter (where event_type = 'negotiation' and last_rank = 1),
    max(event_at) filter (where event_type = 'sale' and first_rank = 1),
    max(event_at) filter (where event_type = 'sale' and last_rank = 1),
    max(org_staff_id) filter (where event_type = 'sale' and first_rank = 1),
    max(org_staff_id) filter (where event_type = 'sale' and last_rank = 1)
  into
    v_first_interest_at,
    v_last_interest_at,
    v_first_interest_staff_id,
    v_last_interest_staff_id,
    v_first_demo_at,
    v_last_demo_at,
    v_first_demo_staff_id,
    v_last_demo_staff_id,
    v_first_negotiation_at,
    v_last_negotiation_at,
    v_first_negotiation_staff_id,
    v_last_negotiation_staff_id,
    v_first_sale_at,
    v_last_sale_at,
    v_first_sale_staff_id,
    v_last_sale_staff_id
  from ranked;

  v_previous_projection_setting := pg_catalog.current_setting(
    'app.aka_customer_lifecycle_projection',
    true
  );
  perform pg_catalog.set_config(
    'app.aka_customer_lifecycle_projection',
    'on',
    true
  );

  update public.aka_customer as customer
  set
    first_interest_at = v_first_interest_at,
    last_interest_at = v_last_interest_at,
    first_interest_staff_id = v_first_interest_staff_id,
    last_interest_staff_id = v_last_interest_staff_id,
    first_demo_at = v_first_demo_at,
    last_demo_at = v_last_demo_at,
    first_demo_staff_id = v_first_demo_staff_id,
    last_demo_staff_id = v_last_demo_staff_id,
    first_negotiation_at = v_first_negotiation_at,
    last_negotiation_at = v_last_negotiation_at,
    first_negotiation_staff_id = v_first_negotiation_staff_id,
    last_negotiation_staff_id = v_last_negotiation_staff_id,
    first_sale_at = v_first_sale_at,
    last_sale_at = v_last_sale_at,
    first_sale_staff_id = v_first_sale_staff_id,
    last_sale_staff_id = v_last_sale_staff_id
  where customer.id = p_customer_id
    and (
      customer.first_interest_at,
      customer.last_interest_at,
      customer.first_interest_staff_id,
      customer.last_interest_staff_id,
      customer.first_demo_at,
      customer.last_demo_at,
      customer.first_demo_staff_id,
      customer.last_demo_staff_id,
      customer.first_negotiation_at,
      customer.last_negotiation_at,
      customer.first_negotiation_staff_id,
      customer.last_negotiation_staff_id,
      customer.first_sale_at,
      customer.last_sale_at,
      customer.first_sale_staff_id,
      customer.last_sale_staff_id
    ) is distinct from (
      v_first_interest_at,
      v_last_interest_at,
      v_first_interest_staff_id,
      v_last_interest_staff_id,
      v_first_demo_at,
      v_last_demo_at,
      v_first_demo_staff_id,
      v_last_demo_staff_id,
      v_first_negotiation_at,
      v_last_negotiation_at,
      v_first_negotiation_staff_id,
      v_last_negotiation_staff_id,
      v_first_sale_at,
      v_last_sale_at,
      v_first_sale_staff_id,
      v_last_sale_staff_id
    );

  perform pg_catalog.set_config(
    'app.aka_customer_lifecycle_projection',
    coalesce(v_previous_projection_setting, ''),
    true
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.resolve_lifecycle_org_staff_id(p_org_staff_id bigint, p_sql_staff_id bigint, p_chat_staff_id uuid)

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE

  where staff.id = p_org_staff_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_aka_crm_customer_lifecycle(p_crm aka_crm)
 RETURNS bigint[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_customer_ids bigint[];
  v_org_staff_id bigint;
  v_staff_quality text;
  v_source_changed_at timestamptz;
begin
  if p_crm.id is null then
    return '{}'::bigint[];
  end if;

  v_customer_ids := private.invalidate_aka_customer_lifecycle_source(
    'aka_crm',
    p_crm.id
  );

  if p_crm.customer_id is null or p_crm.cskh_completed_date is null then
    return v_customer_ids;
  end if;

  v_org_staff_id := private.resolve_lifecycle_org_staff_id(
    p_crm.completed_by_org_staff_id,
    null,
    null
  );
  v_staff_quality := private.lifecycle_staff_quality(
    v_org_staff_id,
    p_crm.completed_by_org_staff_id,
    null,
    null
  );
  v_source_changed_at := coalesce(
    p_crm.updated_at,
    p_crm.cskh_completed_date,
    pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  );

  if p_crm.interest_date is not null then
    perform private.upsert_aka_customer_lifecycle_event(
      p_crm.customer_id,
      'interest',
      p_crm.interest_date,
      v_org_staff_id,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_org_product_customer_lifecycle(p_product org_organization_product)
 RETURNS bigint[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_customer_ids bigint[];
  v_customer_id bigint;
  v_is_demo boolean;
  v_org_staff_id bigint;
  v_staff_quality text;
  v_source_changed_at timestamptz;
begin
  if p_product.id is null then
    return '{}'::bigint[];
  end if;

  v_customer_ids := private.invalidate_aka_customer_lifecycle_source(
    'org_organization_product',
    p_product.id
  );

  select organization.customer_id
  into v_customer_id
  from public.org_organization as organization
  where organization.id = p_product.organization_id;

  if v_customer_id is null then
    return v_customer_ids;
  end if;

  v_source_changed_at := coalesce(
    p_product.updated_at,
    p_product.created_at,
    pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  );
  v_is_demo := private.lifecycle_package_is_demo(
    p_product.package_type,
    p_product.package_name,
    true
  );

  if p_product.demo_created_at is not null then
    v_org_staff_id := private.resolve_lifecycle_org_staff_id(
      p_product.demo_created_by,
      null,
      null
    );
    v_staff_quality := private.lifecycle_staff_quality(
      v_org_staff_id,
      p_product.demo_created_by,
      null,
      null
    );
    perform private.upsert_aka_customer_lifecycle_event(
      v_customer_id,
      'demo',
      p_product.demo_created_at,
      v_org_staff_id,
      'org_organization_product',
      p_product.id,
      'demo-first',
      'exact',
      v_staff_quality,
      25,
      v_source_changed_at
    );
  end if;

  if v_is_demo and not coalesce(p_product.is_deleted, false) then
    v_org_staff_id := private.resolve_lifecycle_org_staff_id(
      coalesce(
        p_product.updated_by,
        p_product.demo_created_by,
        p_product.created_by
      ),
      null,
      null
    );
    v_staff_quality := private.lifecycle_staff_quality(
      v_org_staff_id,
      coalesce(
        p_product.updated_by,
        p_product.demo_created_by,
        p_product.created_by
      ),
      null,
      null
    );
    perform private.upsert_aka_customer_lifecycle_event(
      v_customer_id,
      'demo',
      coalesce(
        p_product.trial_start_date,
        p_product.demo_created_at,
        p_product.created_at
      ),
      v_org_staff_id,
      'org_organization_product',
      p_product.id,
      'demo-current',
      case when p_product.trial_start_date is not null
        or p_product.demo_created_at is not null
        then 'exact' else 'inferred' end,
      v_staff_quality,
      35,
      v_source_changed_at
    );
  end if;

  if p_product.first_sale_at is not null
     and not v_is_demo
     and coalesce(p_product.is_paid, false) then
    v_org_staff_id := private.resolve_lifecycle_org_staff_id(
      p_product.first_sale_by,
      null,
      null
    );
    v_staff_quality := private.lifecycle_staff_quality(
      v_org_staff_id,
      p_product.first_sale_by,
      null,
      null
    );
    perform private.upsert_aka_customer_lifecycle_event(
      v_customer_id,
      'sale',
      p_product.first_sale_at,
      v_org_staff_id,
      'org_organization_product',
      p_product.id,
      'sale-first',
      'exact',
      v_staff_quality,
      25,
      v_source_changed_at
    );
  end if;

  if not v_is_demo
     and coalesce(p_product.is_paid, false)
     and not coalesce(p_product.is_deleted, false)
     and coalesce(
       p_product.purchase_date,
       p_product.first_sale_at
     ) is not null then
    v_org_staff_id := private.resolve_lifecycle_org_staff_id(
      case
        when p_product.purchase_date is not distinct from
             p_product.first_sale_at
          then p_product.first_sale_by
        else p_product.updated_by
      end,
      null,
      null
    );
    v_staff_quality := private.lifecycle_staff_quality(
      v_org_staff_id,
      case
        when p_product.purchase_date is not distinct from
             p_product.first_sale_at
          then p_product.first_sale_by
        else p_product.updated_by
      end,
      null,
      null
    );
    perform private.upsert_aka_customer_lifecycle_event(
      v_customer_id,
      'sale',
      coalesce(
        p_product.purchase_date,
        p_product.first_sale_at
      ),
      v_org_staff_id,
      'org_organization_product',
      p_product.id,
      'sale-current',
      case when p_product.purchase_date is not null
        or p_product.first_sale_at is not null
        then 'exact' else 'inferred' end,
      v_staff_quality,
      35,
      v_source_changed_at
    );
  end if;

  return coalesce(v_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[])
    || array[v_customer_id]::bigint[];
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.trg_reassign_org_customer_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_customer_ids bigint[] := array_remove(
    array[old.customer_id, new.customer_id]::bigint[],
    null
  );
  v_product public.org_organization_product%rowtype;
  v_history public.org_organization_product_history%rowtype;
  v_order public.aka_order%rowtype;
  v_order_history public.aka_order_history%rowtype;
begin
  if old.customer_id is not distinct from new.customer_id then
    return new;
  end if;

  for v_product in
    select product.*
    from public.org_organization_product as product
    where product.organization_id = new.id
    order by product.id
  loop
    v_customer_ids := coalesce(v_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[])
      || private.sync_org_product_customer_lifecycle(v_product);
  end loop;

  for v_history in
    select history.*
    from public.org_organization_product_history as history
    where history.organization_id = new.id
    order by history.id
  loop
    v_customer_ids := coalesce(v_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[])
      || private.sync_org_product_history_customer_lifecycle(v_history);
  end loop;

  -- SQL/manual orders with no direct customer use the organization link as a
  -- fallback. Recompute both current and append-only order evidence when that
  -- link moves; org_product mirror orders remain excluded by the sync helper.
  for v_order in
    select order_row.*
    from public.aka_order as order_row
    where order_row.organization_id = new.id
      and order_row.customer_id is null
      and order_row.source_system in ('sql_account', 'legacy_manual')
    order by order_row.id
  loop
    v_customer_ids := coalesce(v_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[])
      || private.sync_aka_order_customer_lifecycle(v_order);

    for v_order_history in
      select history.*
      from public.aka_order_history as history
      where history.aka_order_id = v_order.id
      order by history.id
    loop
      v_customer_ids := coalesce(v_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[])
        || private.sync_aka_order_history_customer_lifecycle(v_order_history);
    end loop;
  end loop;

  perform private.refresh_aka_customer_lifecycle_projections(v_customer_ids);
  return new;
end
$function$

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO ''

declare

begin

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.upsert_aka_customer_lifecycle_event(p_customer_id bigint, p_event_type text, p_event_at timestamp with time zone, p_org_staff_id bigint, p_source_table text, p_source_row_id bigint, p_source_suffix text, p_date_quality text, p_staff_quality text, p_source_priority integer, p_source_changed_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_source_event_key text;
begin
  if p_customer_id is null
     or p_event_at is null
     or p_source_row_id is null
     or p_source_priority not between 1 and 1000
     or not exists (
       select 1
       from public.aka_customer as customer
       where customer.id = p_customer_id
     ) then
    return false;
  end if;

  v_source_event_key := p_source_table || ':'
    || p_source_row_id::text || ':' || p_source_suffix;

  insert into public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event (
    customer_id,
    event_type,
    event_at,
    org_staff_id,
    source_table,
    source_row_id,
    source_event_key,
    date_quality,
    staff_quality,
    source_priority,
    source_changed_at,
    invalidated_at
  ) values (
    p_customer_id,
    p_event_type,
    p_event_at,
    p_org_staff_id,
    p_source_table,
    p_source_row_id,
    v_source_event_key,
    p_date_quality,
    p_staff_quality,
    p_source_priority,
    coalesce(p_source_changed_at, pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()),
    null
  )
  on conflict (source_event_key)
  do update set
    customer_id = excluded.customer_id,
    event_type = excluded.event_type,
    event_at = excluded.event_at,
    org_staff_id = case
      when public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event.event_at
             is distinct from excluded.event_at
        or (
          public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event.invalidated_at is not null
          and public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event.invalidated_at
              < pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
        )
        then excluded.org_staff_id
      else public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event.org_staff_id
    end,
    source_table = excluded.source_table,
    source_row_id = excluded.source_row_id,
    date_quality = excluded.date_quality,
    staff_quality = case
      when public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event.event_at
             is distinct from excluded.event_at
        or (
          public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event.invalidated_at is not null
          and public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event.invalidated_at
              < pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
        )
        then excluded.staff_quality
      else public.aka_customer_lifecycle_event.staff_quality
    end,
    source_priority = excluded.source_priority,
    source_changed_at = excluded.source_changed_at,
    invalidated_at = null;

  return true;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.aka_agent_capture_table_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_new jsonb;
  v_old jsonb;
  v_pk jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_column text;
BEGIN
  -- No schema is stored. Restrict registration to public source tables,
  -- excluding the audit table itself. No catalog query is needed per row.
  IF TG_TABLE_SCHEMA <> 'public' OR TG_TABLE_NAME='auto_table_logs' OR TG_WHEN <> 'AFTER' OR TG_LEVEL <> 'ROW'
     OR TG_OP NOT IN ('INSERT','UPDATE') OR TG_NARGS<2
     OR TG_ARGV[0] NOT IN ('campaign_config_v1','error_config_v1') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='invalid table log trigger configuration';
  END IF;
  -- Explicit campaign projection never reads/serializes the large log column.
  -- original_schedule is configured time; schedule is the next runtime slot.
  -- Empty/NULL settings and runtime-only settings have the same config value.
  IF TG_ARGV[0]='campaign_config_v1' THEN
    v_new := jsonb_build_object(
      'id',NEW.id,
      'name',NEW.name,
      'action_id',NEW.action_id,
      'account_id',NEW.account_id,
      'secondary_account_id',NEW.secondary_account_id,
      'is_delete',NEW.is_delete,
      'content',NEW.content,
      'original_schedule',NEW.original_schedule,
      'schedule_type',NEW.schedule_type,
      'schedule_end_date',NEW.schedule_end_date,
      'schedule_days',NEW.schedule_days,
      'schedule_week_days',NEW.schedule_week_days,
      'continue_next_day',NEW.continue_next_day,
      'refresh_data',NEW.refresh_data,
      'extra_settings',CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(NEW.extra_settings)='object' THEN nullif(NEW.extra_settings - ARRAY['sourceLinkIndex','contentRotationIndex','postBumpRotationIndex','internalSmsCreatedCampaignIdsByAccount','postBumpCreatedCampaignIdsByAccount','zaloFriendDataMaterializedAt','zaloFriendMaterializedCount','zaloBirthdayDataMaterializedDate','zaloBirthdayMaterializedCount','zaloFriendRecommendationDataMaterializedAt','zaloFriendRecommendationMaterializedCount','zaloCancelFriendRequestDataMaterializedAt','zaloCancelFriendRequestMaterializedCount'], '{}'::jsonb) ELSE NEW.extra_settings END,
      'images',NEW.images,
      'staff_id',NEW.staff_id,
      'organization_id',NEW.organization_id,
      'daily_stop_time',NEW.daily_stop_time,
      'time_sleep_between_2',NEW.time_sleep_between_2,
      'data_target_source_mode',NEW.data_target_source_mode,
      'data_group_id',NEW.data_group_id
    );
    IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
      v_old := jsonb_build_object(
      'id',OLD.id,
      'name',OLD.name,
      'action_id',OLD.action_id,
      'account_id',OLD.account_id,
      'secondary_account_id',OLD.secondary_account_id,
      'is_delete',OLD.is_delete,
      'content',OLD.content,
      'original_schedule',OLD.original_schedule,
      'schedule_type',OLD.schedule_type,
      'schedule_end_date',OLD.schedule_end_date,
      'schedule_days',OLD.schedule_days,
      'schedule_week_days',OLD.schedule_week_days,
      'continue_next_day',OLD.continue_next_day,
      'refresh_data',OLD.refresh_data,
      'extra_settings',CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(OLD.extra_settings)='object' THEN nullif(OLD.extra_settings - ARRAY['sourceLinkIndex','contentRotationIndex','postBumpRotationIndex','internalSmsCreatedCampaignIdsByAccount','postBumpCreatedCampaignIdsByAccount','zaloFriendDataMaterializedAt','zaloFriendMaterializedCount','zaloBirthdayDataMaterializedDate','zaloBirthdayMaterializedCount','zaloFriendRecommendationDataMaterializedAt','zaloFriendRecommendationMaterializedCount','zaloCancelFriendRequestDataMaterializedAt','zaloCancelFriendRequestMaterializedCount'], '{}'::jsonb) ELSE OLD.extra_settings END,
      'images',OLD.images,
      'staff_id',OLD.staff_id,
      'organization_id',OLD.organization_id,
      'daily_stop_time',OLD.daily_stop_time,
      'time_sleep_between_2',OLD.time_sleep_between_2,
      'data_target_source_mode',OLD.data_target_source_mode,
      'data_group_id',OLD.data_group_id
    );
    END IF;
  ELSE
    -- auto_error is a policy catalog, not an error-event stream.
    v_new := to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY['created_at','updated_at'];
    IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
      v_old := to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY['created_at','updated_at'];
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND v_old IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_new THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  -- Profile first, then the primary-key column names (including composite keys).
  FOREACH v_column IN ARRAY TG_ARGV[1:TG_NARGS-1] LOOP
    IF v_column IS NULL OR NOT (v_new ? v_column) OR v_new->v_column='null'::jsonb THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='invalid table log primary key column';
    END IF;
    v_pk := v_pk || jsonb_build_object(v_column,v_new->v_column);
  END LOOP;
  INSERT INTO public.auto_table_logs(table_name,record_pk,operation,old_data,new_data)
    VALUES (TG_TABLE_NAME,v_pk,TG_OP,v_old,v_new);
  RETURN NULL; -- ignored for AFTER ROW triggers
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- Do not include SQLERRM/DETAIL/row values (they can contain credentials).
  -- Cancellation/assertion failures remain PostgreSQL errors; no retry/queue.
  RAISE WARNING 'auto_table_logs: capture skipped (SQLSTATE %)', SQLSTATE;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.find_unified_web_crm_candidate(p_visit_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(visit_id uuid, visit_at timestamp with time zone, page_url text, page_title text, matched_by text, customer_id bigint, customer_name text, customer_phone text, pancake_link text, org_staff_owner_id bigint, candidate_reason text, can_cross_sell boolean, current_products text[], current_product_buckets text[], term_group text, package_name text, product_list text, expiration_at timestamp with time zone, expiration_date date, expiration_source text, days_left integer, source_order_id bigint, organization_product_id bigint, base_crm_type_id bigint, base_crm_type_name text, exact_note text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with visit as (
  select
    web.id,
    coalesce(web.created_at, pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()) as visit_at,
    web.page_url,
    web.page_title,
    case when web.ip_address is null then null else pg_catalog.host(web.ip_address) end as ip_key,
    public.normalize_phone(
      (pg_catalog.regexp_match(coalesce(web.page_url, ''), '[?&]phone=([0-9+]+)', 'i'))[1]
    ) as page_phone
  from public.aka_web_visits as web
  where web.id = p_visit_id
),
ip_resolution as (
  select
    pg_catalog.min(customer.id) as customer_id,
    pg_catalog.count(distinct customer.id) as customer_count
  from visit
  join public.aka_customer as customer
    on visit.ip_key is not null
   and customer.ip_address = visit.ip_key
),
phone_customer_ids as (
  select distinct customer.id as customer_id
  from visit
  join public.aka_customer as customer
    on visit.page_phone is not null
   and pg_catalog.length(visit.page_phone) between 9 and 15
   and public.normalize_phone(customer.phone) = visit.page_phone

  union

  select distinct contact.customer_id
  from visit
  join public.contacts as contact
    on visit.page_phone is not null
   and pg_catalog.length(visit.page_phone) between 9 and 15
   and contact.customer_id is not null
   and not coalesce(contact.is_hidden, false)
  cross join lateral pg_catalog.unnest(
    pg_catalog.array_prepend(contact.phone, coalesce(contact.phone_list, '{}'::text[]))
  ) as contact_phone(raw_phone)
  where public.normalize_phone(contact_phone.raw_phone) = visit.page_phone
),
phone_resolution as (
  select
    pg_catalog.min(phone_customer_ids.customer_id) as customer_id,
    pg_catalog.count(distinct phone_customer_ids.customer_id) as customer_count
  from phone_customer_ids
),
-- aka_web_visits.customer_id is a tracking UUID, not aka_customer.id (bigint).
-- A unique explicit phone is therefore the strongest identity signal; unique
-- aka_customer.ip_address is the fallback when no unique phone match exists.
resolved as (
  select
    visit.*,
    case
      when phone_resolution.customer_count = 1 then phone_resolution.customer_id
      when ip_resolution.customer_count = 1 then ip_resolution.customer_id
      else null
    end as customer_id,
    case
      when phone_resolution.customer_count = 1 then 'page_phone'
      when ip_resolution.customer_count = 1 then 'unique_ip_customer'
      else null
    end as matched_by
  from visit
  cross join ip_resolution
  cross join phone_resolution
),
customer as (
  select
    resolved.*,
    customer.name as customer_name,
    customer.phone as aka_customer_phone,
    customer.inbox_url,
    customer.org_staff_id_owner
  from resolved
  join public.aka_customer as customer on customer.id = resolved.customer_id
),
reachable_phone as (
  select phone.customer_id, phone.normalized_phone
  from (
    select
      customer.customer_id,
      public.normalize_phone(raw_phone.phone) as normalized_phone,
      raw_phone.priority,
      raw_phone.contact_updated_at
    from customer
    cross join lateral (
      select customer.aka_customer_phone as phone, 1 as priority, null::timestamptz as contact_updated_at

      union all

      select contact.phone, 2, contact.updated_at
      from public.contacts as contact
      where contact.customer_id = customer.customer_id
        and not coalesce(contact.is_hidden, false)

      union all

      select phone_list.phone, 3, contact.updated_at
      from public.contacts as contact
      cross join lateral pg_catalog.unnest(coalesce(contact.phone_list, '{}'::text[])) as phone_list(phone)
      where contact.customer_id = customer.customer_id
        and not coalesce(contact.is_hidden, false)
    ) as raw_phone
  ) as phone
  where pg_catalog.length(phone.normalized_phone) between 9 and 15
  order by phone.priority, phone.contact_updated_at desc nulls last, phone.normalized_phone
  limit 1
),
canonical_pancake as (
  select
    customer.customer_id,
    case
      when pg_catalog.btrim(contact.conversion_id)
        ~ '^pzl_[ug]_[0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$' then
        pg_catalog.format(
          'https://pancake.vn/pzl_%s?c_id=%s',
          (pg_catalog.regexp_match(
            pg_catalog.btrim(contact.conversion_id),
            '^pzl_[ug]_([0-9]+)_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
          ))[1],
          pg_catalog.btrim(contact.conversion_id)
        )
      when pg_catalog.btrim(contact.conversion_id)
        ~ '^[0-9]+_[0-9]+$' then
        pg_catalog.format(
          'https://pancake.vn/%s?c_id=%s',
          (pg_catalog.regexp_match(
            pg_catalog.btrim(contact.conversion_id),
            '^([0-9]+)_[0-9]+$'
          ))[1],
          pg_catalog.btrim(contact.conversion_id)
        )
    end as pancake_link
  from customer
  join public.contacts as contact
    on contact.customer_id = customer.customer_id
   and not coalesce(contact.is_hidden, false)
  where pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(contact.conversion_id, ''))
          ~ '^pzl_[ug]_[0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
     or pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(contact.conversion_id, ''))
          ~ '^[0-9]+_[0-9]+$'
  order by contact.last_message_at desc nulls last, contact.updated_at desc nulls last, contact.id desc
  limit 1
),
safe_customer_inbox as (
  select
    customer.customer_id,
    pg_catalog.btrim(customer.inbox_url) as pancake_link
  from customer
  where pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(customer.inbox_url, ''))
          ~* '^https://([[:alnum:]-]+[.])*pancake[.]vn/[^[:space:]]*[?&]c_id=[^&[:space:]]+'
    and pg_catalog.btrim(customer.inbox_url) !~* 'multi_pages'
    and pg_catalog.strpos(
      pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.substr(pg_catalog.btrim(customer.inbox_url), 9)),
      'https://'
    ) = 0
),
reachable_customer as (
  select
    customer.*,
    reachable_phone.normalized_phone as customer_phone,
    coalesce(canonical_pancake.pancake_link, safe_customer_inbox.pancake_link) as pancake_link
  from customer
  left join reachable_phone on reachable_phone.customer_id = customer.customer_id
  left join canonical_pancake on canonical_pancake.customer_id = customer.customer_id
  left join safe_customer_inbox on safe_customer_inbox.customer_id = customer.customer_id
  where reachable_phone.normalized_phone is not null
     or canonical_pancake.pancake_link is not null
     or safe_customer_inbox.pancake_link is not null
),
raw_entitlements as (
  select
    'aka_order'::text as entitlement_source,
    order_row.id as entitlement_row_id,
    case
      when order_row.account_id_old is not null
        and nullif(pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(order_row.product_list, ''))), '') is not null
        then 'account:' || order_row.account_id_old::text
          || ':products:' || pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(order_row.product_list))
      when order_row.account_id_old is not null then 'account:' || order_row.account_id_old::text
      when nullif(pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(order_row.product_list, ''))), '') is not null
        then 'products:' || pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(order_row.product_list))
      else 'order:' || order_row.id::text
    end as logical_key,
    case
      when coalesce(order_row.is_demo, false)
        or pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(order_row.package, ''))) in ('demo', 'free')
        then 'demo'
      else 'paid'
    end as entitlement_class,
    case
      when pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(order_row.package, '')))
        in ('forever', 'unlimited', 'lifetime') then 'other'
      when order_row.date_expiration is not null
        and pg_catalog.date_part('year', order_row.date_expiration) >= 2090 then 'other'
      when order_row.date_create is not null and order_row.date_expiration is not null
        and (order_row.date_expiration::date - order_row.date_create::date) >= 1500 then 'other'
      when pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(order_row.package, ''))) ~ 'month$' then 'month'
      when pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(order_row.package, ''))) ~ 'year$' then 'year'
      when order_row.date_create is not null and order_row.date_expiration is not null
        and (order_row.date_expiration::date - order_row.date_create::date)
          between 200 and 1499 then 'year'
      when order_row.date_create is not null and order_row.date_expiration is not null
        and (order_row.date_expiration::date - order_row.date_create::date)
          between 1 and 199 then 'month'
      else 'other'
    end as term_group,
    nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(order_row.package), '') as package_name,
    nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(order_row.product_list), '') as product_list,
    order_row.date_expiration as expires_at,
    coalesce(order_row.is_active, true)
      and (order_row.date_expiration is null or order_row.date_expiration >= reachable_customer.visit_at) as is_active,
    order_row.date_expiration is not null
      and order_row.date_expiration < reachable_customer.visit_at as is_expired,
    order_row.updated_at,
    order_row.id as source_order_id,
    null::bigint as organization_product_id
  from reachable_customer
  join public.aka_order as order_row
    on order_row.customer_id = reachable_customer.customer_id
    or (
      order_row.customer_id is null
      and reachable_customer.customer_phone is not null
      and public.normalize_phone(order_row.phone) = reachable_customer.customer_phone
    )
  where coalesce(order_row.date_create, order_row.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
          <= reachable_customer.visit_at

  union all

  select
    'org_organization_product',
    organization_product.id,
    'product:' || coalesce(
      organization_product.product_id::text,
      organization_product.product_package_id::text,
      pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(organization_product.product_name, ''))),
      organization_product.id::text
    ),
    case when coalesce(organization_product.is_paid, false) then 'paid' else 'demo' end,
    case
      when pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(organization_product.package_type, '')))
        in ('forever', 'unlimited', 'lifetime') then 'other'
      when pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(organization_product.package_type, ''))) ~ 'month$' then 'month'
      when pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(organization_product.package_type, ''))) ~ 'year$' then 'year'
      when organization_product.duration_days between 1 and 199 then 'month'
      when organization_product.duration_days between 200 and 1499 then 'year'
      else 'other'
    end,
    coalesce(
      nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(organization_product.package_name), ''),
      nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(organization_product.package_type), '')
    ),
    nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(organization_product.product_name), ''),
    organization_product.expiration_date,
    not coalesce(organization_product.is_deleted, false)
      and not coalesce(organization_product.is_lock, false)
      and (
        organization_product.expiration_date is null
        or organization_product.expiration_date >= reachable_customer.visit_at
      ),
    organization_product.expiration_date is not null
      and organization_product.expiration_date < reachable_customer.visit_at,
    organization_product.updated_at,
    null::bigint,
    organization_product.id
  from reachable_customer
  join public.org_organization as organization
    on organization.customer_id = reachable_customer.customer_id
    or (
      organization.customer_id is null
      and reachable_customer.customer_phone is not null
      and public.normalize_phone(organization.phone) = reachable_customer.customer_phone
    )
  join public.org_organization_product as organization_product
    on organization_product.organization_id = organization.id
  where not coalesce(organization_product.is_deleted, false)
    and coalesce(
      organization_product.purchase_date,
      organization_product.trial_start_date,
      organization_product.created_at,
      '-infinity'::timestamptz
    ) <= reachable_customer.visit_at
),
ranked_entitlements as (
  select
    raw_entitlements.*,
    pg_catalog.row_number() over (
      partition by raw_entitlements.entitlement_source, raw_entitlements.logical_key
      order by raw_entitlements.is_active desc,
               case
                 when raw_entitlements.is_active and raw_entitlements.expires_at is null then 1
                 else 0
               end desc,
               raw_entitlements.expires_at desc nulls last,
               raw_entitlements.updated_at desc nulls last,
               raw_entitlements.entitlement_row_id desc
    ) as logical_rank
  from raw_entitlements
),
latest_entitlements as (
  select
    ranked_entitlements.*,
    case
      when ranked_entitlements.expires_at is null then null
      else
        (ranked_entitlements.expires_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date
        - (reachable_customer.visit_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date
    end as days_left
  from ranked_entitlements
  cross join reachable_customer
  where ranked_entitlements.logical_rank = 1
),
entitlement_stats as (
  select
    pg_catalog.count(latest_entitlements.entitlement_row_id) > 0 as has_history,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(latest_entitlements.is_active), false) as has_active,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(
      latest_entitlements.is_active
      and latest_entitlements.entitlement_class = 'paid'
      and latest_entitlements.term_group in ('month', 'year')
      and latest_entitlements.days_left between 1 and 15
    ), false) as has_near_expiry,
    pg_catalog.array_remove(
      pg_catalog.array_agg(distinct latest_entitlements.product_list) filter (
        where latest_entitlements.is_active
          and latest_entitlements.product_list is not null
      ),
      null
    ) as current_products
  from latest_entitlements
),
latest_expired as (
  select latest_entitlements.*
  from latest_entitlements
  where latest_entitlements.is_expired
  order by latest_entitlements.expires_at desc nulls last,
           case latest_entitlements.entitlement_class when 'paid' then 0 else 1 end,
           latest_entitlements.entitlement_row_id desc
  limit 1
),
classification as (
  select
    case
      when entitlement_stats.has_near_expiry then 'near_expiry'
      when entitlement_stats.has_active then 'active_other'
      when latest_expired.entitlement_class = 'paid' then 'expired_paid'
      when latest_expired.entitlement_class = 'demo' then 'expired_demo'
      when entitlement_stats.has_history then 'active_other'
      else 'unused'
    end as candidate_reason,
    entitlement_stats.has_active
      and coalesce(pg_catalog.cardinality(entitlement_stats.current_products), 0) > 0 as can_cross_sell,
    coalesce(entitlement_stats.current_products, '{}'::text[]) as current_products
  from entitlement_stats
  left join latest_expired on true
),
selected_entitlement as (
  select latest_entitlements.*
  from latest_entitlements
  cross join classification
  where
    (
      classification.candidate_reason = 'near_expiry'
      and latest_entitlements.is_active
      and latest_entitlements.entitlement_class = 'paid'
      and latest_entitlements.term_group in ('month', 'year')
      and latest_entitlements.days_left between 1 and 15
    )
    or (
      classification.candidate_reason = 'active_other'
      and latest_entitlements.is_active
    )
    or (
      classification.candidate_reason in ('expired_paid', 'expired_demo')
      and latest_entitlements.is_expired
      and latest_entitlements.entitlement_class =
        case classification.candidate_reason when 'expired_paid' then 'paid' else 'demo' end
    )
  order by
    case when classification.candidate_reason = 'near_expiry' then latest_entitlements.days_left end asc nulls last,
    case when classification.candidate_reason = 'active_other' then latest_entitlements.expires_at end asc nulls last,
    case when classification.candidate_reason in ('expired_paid', 'expired_demo')
      then latest_entitlements.expires_at end desc nulls last,
    latest_entitlements.entitlement_row_id desc
  limit 1
),
product_text as (
  select pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.array_to_string(classification.current_products, ' ')) as value
  from classification
),
type_contract as (
  select
    classification.candidate_reason,
    case classification.candidate_reason
      when 'near_expiry' then near_expiry_type.id
      when 'expired_paid' then 8::bigint
      when 'expired_demo' then 9::bigint
      when 'unused' then 2::bigint
      else null::bigint
    end as base_crm_type_id,
    case classification.candidate_reason
      when 'near_expiry' then near_expiry_type.name
      when 'expired_paid' then 'CSKH truy cập web - Đã hết hạn sử dụng'
      when 'expired_demo' then 'CSKH truy cập web - Đã hết hạn Demo'
      when 'unused' then 'Call KH mới - Khách trở lại'
      else null::text
    end as base_crm_type_name
  from classification
  left join public.aka_crm_type as near_expiry_type
    on near_expiry_type.name = 'KH active - Gần hết hạn'
   and near_expiry_type.is_active = true
)
select
  reachable_customer.id,
  reachable_customer.visit_at,
  reachable_customer.page_url,
  reachable_customer.page_title,
  reachable_customer.matched_by,
  reachable_customer.customer_id,
  reachable_customer.customer_name,
  reachable_customer.customer_phone,
  reachable_customer.pancake_link,
  reachable_customer.org_staff_id_owner,
  classification.candidate_reason,
  classification.can_cross_sell,
  classification.current_products,
  pg_catalog.array_remove(array[
    case when product_text.value like '%zalo%' then 'zalo' end,
    case when product_text.value like '%fanpage%' then 'fanpage' end,
    case when product_text.value like '%facebook%' or product_text.value like '%fbextension%' then 'facebook' end,
    case when product_text.value like '%sms%' then 'sms' end,
    case when product_text.value like '%email%' then 'email' end,
    case when product_text.value like '%chat%' then 'chat' end,
    case when product_text.value like '%akamap%' or product_text.value like '%googlemap%'
      or product_text.value like '%google-map%' then 'map' end
  ]::text[], null),
  selected_entitlement.term_group,
  selected_entitlement.package_name,
  selected_entitlement.product_list,
  selected_entitlement.expires_at,
  case when selected_entitlement.expires_at is null then null else
    (selected_entitlement.expires_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date
  end,
  selected_entitlement.entitlement_source,
  selected_entitlement.days_left,
  selected_entitlement.source_order_id,
  selected_entitlement.organization_product_id,
  type_contract.base_crm_type_id,
  type_contract.base_crm_type_name,
  case when classification.candidate_reason = 'near_expiry' then
    pg_catalog.format(
      'Khách hàng truy cập web. Còn %s ngày là hết hạn',
      selected_entitlement.days_left
    )
  end
from reachable_customer
cross join classification
cross join product_text
cross join type_contract
left join selected_entitlement on true
where classification.candidate_reason <> 'unused'
   or private.classify_birthday_customer_v1(
        reachable_customer.customer_id,
        (pg_catalog.statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date
      ) ->> 'status' = 'never_purchased';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.bigint_array_has_unique_elements(values_to_check bigint[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select cardinality(values_to_check) = count(distinct value)
  from unnest(values_to_check) as entries(value);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.detach_deleted_auto_content_secondary_group()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.auto_content_templates
  set secondary_group_ids = array_remove(secondary_group_ids, new.id),
      updated_at = now()
  where new.id = any (secondary_group_ids);

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.trg_audit_aka_order_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_before public.aka_order%rowtype;
  v_after public.aka_order%rowtype;
  v_before_snapshot jsonb;
  v_after_snapshot jsonb;
  v_before_order jsonb;
  v_after_order jsonb;
  v_changed_fields text[];
  v_field_changes jsonb;
  v_change_categories text[];
  v_context jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_context_text text;
  v_operation text;
  v_primary_event_type text;
  v_event_scope text;
  v_event_origin text;
  v_outcome text;
  v_history_id bigint;
  v_event_key text;
  v_payload_hash text;
  v_source_system text;
  v_source_record_id bigint;
  v_aka_order_id bigint;
  v_auth_user_id uuid;
  v_actor_org_staff_id bigint;
  v_actor_sql_staff_id bigint;
  v_actor_kind text;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_actor_source text;
  v_actor_name text;
  v_actor_username text;
  v_source_actor_id text;
  v_package_change_kind text;
  v_changed_at timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    v_after := new;
    v_operation := 'INSERT';
  elsif tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    v_before := old;
    v_operation := 'DELETE';
  else
    v_before := old;
    v_after := new;
    v_operation := 'UPDATE';
  end if;

  if tg_op <> 'INSERT' then
    v_before_snapshot := private.aka_order_history_order_snapshot(v_before);
    v_before_order := v_before_snapshot -> 'order';
  end if;
  if tg_op <> 'DELETE' then
    v_after_snapshot := private.aka_order_history_order_snapshot(v_after);
    v_after_order := v_after_snapshot -> 'order';
  end if;

  v_changed_fields := private.aka_order_history_changed_fields(
    v_before_order,
    v_after_order
  );

  -- updated_at/sql_sync_at/sql_sync_type/source_snapshot/sync_version are not in
  -- the projection above. A replay or heartbeat that changes only those fields
  -- therefore creates no audit row and no outbox work.
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and cardinality(v_changed_fields) = 0 then
    return new;
  end if;

  v_field_changes := private.aka_order_history_field_changes(
    v_before_order,
    v_after_order,
    v_changed_fields
  );
  v_change_categories := private.aka_order_history_change_categories(
    v_changed_fields
  );

  v_context_text := pg_catalog.current_setting(
    'app.aka_order_history_context',
    true
  );
  if nullif(v_context_text, '') is not null then
    begin
      v_context := v_context_text::jsonb;
      if pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_context) <> 'object' then
        v_context := '{}'::jsonb;
      end if;
    exception
      when others then
        v_context := '{}'::jsonb;
    end;
  end if;

  v_source_system := coalesce(v_after.source_system, v_before.source_system);
  v_source_record_id := coalesce(
    v_after.source_record_id,
    v_before.source_record_id
  );
  v_aka_order_id := coalesce(v_after.id, v_before.id);

  v_event_scope := case
    when v_context ->> 'event_scope' = any(array[
      'order', 'projection', 'entitlement', 'commercial_order',
      'package', 'purchase', 'payment', 'promotion', 'sync',
      'compensation', 'correction', 'reconciliation', 'system'
    ]::text[]) then v_context ->> 'event_scope'
    else 'projection'
  end;

  v_event_origin := case
    when v_context ->> 'event_origin' = any(array[
      'api_direct', 'org_source_trigger', 'sql_write_through',
      'sql_syncdata', 'sale_order', 'payment_order', 'sepay_webhook',
      'cron', 'reconcile', 'migration_baseline', 'legacy_unknown'
    ]::text[]) then v_context ->> 'event_origin'
    when v_source_system = 'org_product' then 'org_source_trigger'
    when v_source_system = 'sql_account' then 'sql_syncdata'
    else 'sql_write_through'
  end;

  v_outcome := case
    when v_context ->> 'outcome' = any(array[
      'requested', 'committed', 'failed', 'unknown_commit', 'recorded',
      'reconciled', 'compensated', 'baseline'
    ]::text[]) then v_context ->> 'outcome'
    else 'committed'
  end;

  v_primary_event_type := lower(coalesce(
    nullif(v_context ->> 'primary_event_type', ''),
    case tg_op
      when 'INSERT' then 'order_insert'
      when 'UPDATE' then 'order_update'
      else 'order_delete'
    end
  ));
  if v_primary_event_type !~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$' then
    v_primary_event_type := case tg_op
      when 'INSERT' then 'order_insert'
      when 'UPDATE' then 'order_update'
      else 'order_delete'
    end;
  end if;

  begin
    v_auth_user_id := nullif(
      pg_catalog.current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true),
      ''
    )::uuid;
  exception
    when invalid_text_representation then
      v_auth_user_id := null;
  end;

  v_actor_org_staff_id := nullif(nullif(
    v_context ->> 'actor_org_staff_id',
    ''
  )::bigint, 0);
  if v_actor_org_staff_id is null and v_source_system = 'org_product' then
    v_source_actor_id := coalesce(
      v_after.source_snapshot #>> '{org_organization_product,updated_by}',
      v_before.source_snapshot #>> '{org_organization_product,updated_by}',
      v_after.source_snapshot #>> '{org_organization_product,created_by}',
      v_before.source_snapshot #>> '{org_organization_product,created_by}'
    );
    if v_source_actor_id ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' then
      v_actor_org_staff_id := v_source_actor_id::bigint;
    end if;
  end if;
  v_actor_sql_staff_id := coalesce(
    nullif(nullif(v_context ->> 'actor_sql_staff_id', '')::bigint, 0),
    case when tg_op = 'DELETE'
      then case when old.staff_update_id_old > 0
        then old.staff_update_id_old::bigint
      end
      else case when new.staff_update_id_old > 0
        then new.staff_update_id_old::bigint
      end
    end
  );

  if v_actor_org_staff_id is not null then
    select nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(staff.name), ''),
           nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(staff.username), '')
    into v_actor_name, v_actor_username
    from public.org_staff as staff
    where staff.id = v_actor_org_staff_id;
  end if;

  v_actor_kind := case
    when v_actor_org_staff_id is not null then 'org_staff'
    when v_actor_sql_staff_id is not null then 'sql_staff'
    when v_auth_user_id is not null then 'auth_user'
    else 'system'
  end;
  v_actor_role := coalesce(
    nullif(v_context ->> 'actor_role', ''),
    nullif(pg_catalog.current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
    session_user
  );
  v_actor_source := coalesce(
    nullif(v_context ->> 'actor_source', ''),
    case when v_actor_kind = 'system'
      then 'database_role'
      else 'source_projection'
    end
  );

  v_package_change_kind := case
    when tg_op = 'INSERT' then 'activated'
    when tg_op = 'DELETE' then 'removed'
    when (old.product_id, old.product_package_id, old.package, old.package_type)
      is distinct from
      (new.product_id, new.product_package_id, new.package, new.package_type)
      then 'changed'
    else 'unchanged'
  end;

  v_history_id := pg_catalog.nextval(
    'public.aka_order_history_id_seq'::pg_catalog.regclass
  );
  v_event_key := 'db:' || v_history_id::text;
  v_payload_hash := private.aka_order_history_payload_hash(
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'event_key', v_event_key,
      'aka_order_id', v_aka_order_id,
      'source_system', v_source_system,
      'source_record_id', v_source_record_id,
      'operation', v_operation,
      'primary_event_type', v_primary_event_type,
      'event_scope', v_event_scope,
      'event_origin', v_event_origin,
      'outcome', v_outcome,
      'changed_fields', v_changed_fields,
      'field_changes', v_field_changes,
      'before', v_before_snapshot,
      'after', v_after_snapshot,
      'changed_at', v_changed_at
    )
  );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_unit_started(p_campaign bigint, p_account bigint, p_unit uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record;
BEGIN
 SELECT runtime_claim_token, runtime_unit_claimed_at, runtime_unit_vietnam_date INTO c
 FROM public.auto_campaigns WHERE id=p_campaign AND account_id=p_account AND runtime_unit_token=p_unit;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 UPDATE public.auto_account_random_run_days d SET state=jsonb_set(d.state,'{turns}',(
   SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN x->>'claimToken'=c.runtime_claim_token::text AND x->>'status'='running'
     THEN x||jsonb_build_object('unitToken',p_unit,'unitStartedAt',c.runtime_unit_claimed_at) ELSE x END ORDER BY n)
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') WITH ORDINALITY AS a(x,n))), updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE d.account_id=p_account AND d.run_date=c.runtime_unit_vietnam_date
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') x WHERE x->>'claimToken'=c.runtime_claim_token::text AND x->>'status'='running');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_unit_settled(p_campaign bigint, p_account bigint, p_unit uuid, p_cancelled boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record; done integer; seconds integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT runtime_unit_input_data_ids ids, runtime_unit_vietnam_date AS unit_day, runtime_unit_claimed_at started
 INTO c FROM public.auto_campaigns WHERE id=p_campaign AND account_id=p_account AND runtime_unit_token=p_unit;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT count(*)::int INTO done FROM public.auto_campaign_input_data i WHERE i.campaign_id=p_campaign AND i.id=ANY(c.ids)
 AND i.status NOT IN ('chờ xử lý','đang chạy');
 seconds:=greatest(0,floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-c.started))::int);
 UPDATE public.auto_account_random_run_days d SET state=jsonb_set(d.state,'{turns}',(
   SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN x->>'unitToken'=p_unit::text AND x->>'status'='running'
     THEN (x-'unitToken'-'unitStartedAt')||jsonb_build_object(
       'processed',(x->>'processed')::int+CASE WHEN x->>'unit'='data' THEN done WHEN p_cancelled THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
       'elapsedSeconds',CASE WHEN x->>'unit'='minute' AND NOT p_cancelled THEN least((x->>'quantity')::bigint*60,seconds) ELSE coalesce((x->>'elapsedSeconds')::int,0) END,
       'lastUnitToken',p_unit) ELSE x END ORDER BY n)
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') WITH ORDINALITY a(x,n))),updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE d.account_id=p_account AND d.run_date=c.unit_day AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') x WHERE x->>'unitToken'=p_unit::text AND x->>'status'='running');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_claim_allowed(p_campaign bigint, p_account bigint, p_turn text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM public.auto_account_random_run_days d
   JOIN public.auto_accounts a ON a.id=d.account_id,
   LATERAL (SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') WITH ORDINALITY q(x,n)
     WHERE x->>'status' IN ('planned','running') ORDER BY n LIMIT 1) next_turn
   WHERE d.account_id=p_account AND d.run_date=timezone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',clock_timestamp())::date
     AND d.status='open' AND next_turn.x->>'status'='planned'
     AND next_turn.x->>'id'=p_turn AND (next_turn.x->>'campaignId')::bigint=p_campaign
     AND (next_turn.x->>'revision')::int=(a.facebook_random_run_config->>'revision')::int
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.classify_birthday_customer_v1(p_customer_id bigint, p_as_of_date_vn date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_as_of date := coalesce(
    p_as_of_date_vn,
    (pg_catalog.statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date
  );
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if p_customer_id is null
     or not exists (select 1 from public.aka_customer c where c.id = p_customer_id) then
    return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'status', 'state_unknown',
      'as_of_date_vn', v_as_of,
      'has_history', false,
      'history_count', 0,
      'active_count', 0,
      'near_expiry_count', 0,
      'unknown_count', 0,
      'entitlement_unknown_count', 0,
      'payment_sync_pending', false,
      'payment_pending_count', 0,
      'payment_history_count', 0,
      'payment_history_without_entitlement', false,
      'days_left', null,
      'has_paid_history', false,
      'has_demo_history', false,
      'selected_entitlement', null
    );
  end if;

  with entitlement_base as (
    select
      'aka_order'::text as source,
      o.id,
      o.id as order_id,
      null::bigint as organization_product_id,
      null::bigint as product_package_id,
      mapped.product_id,
      mapped.product_code,
      coalesce(mapped.product_name, nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(o.product_list), '')) as product_name,
      nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(o.package), '') as package_name,
      coalesce(o.date_create, o.created_at) as starts_at,
      (o.date_expiration at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date as expires_on,
      (
        pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package, '')) ~
          '(lifetime|forever|unlimited|trọn đời|tron doi|vĩnh viễn|vinh vien)'
        or pg_catalog.date_part('year', o.date_expiration) >= 2090
        or (
          o.date_create is not null and o.date_expiration is not null
          and (o.date_expiration at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date
              - (o.date_create at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date >= 1500
        )
      ) as is_lifetime,
      (
        coalesce(o.is_demo, false)
        or pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package, '')) ~
          '(demo|trial|free|dùng[[:space:]_-]*thử|dung[[:space:]_-]*thu|miễn[[:space:]_-]*phí|mien[[:space:]_-]*phi)'
      ) as is_demo,
      not (
        coalesce(o.is_demo, false)
        or pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package, '')) ~
          '(demo|trial|free|dùng[[:space:]_-]*thử|dung[[:space:]_-]*thu|miễn[[:space:]_-]*phí|mien[[:space:]_-]*phi)'
      ) as is_paid,
      o.is_active is distinct from false as source_enabled,
      o.date_expiration is null as expiration_missing,
      coalesce(
        o.updated_at,
        o.sql_sync_at,
        o.date_last_update,
        o.date_update_package,
        o.date_create,
        o.created_at
      ) as source_updated_at
    from public.aka_order o
    left join lateral (
      select
        min(prod.id) as product_id,
        min(prod.code) as product_code,
        min(prod.name) as product_name
      from public.org_product prod
      where prod.is_active
        and (
          pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(o.product_list, ''))) =
            pg_catalog.lower(prod.code)
          or pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(o.product_list, ''))) =
            pg_catalog.lower(prod.name)
          or exists (
            select 1
            from pg_catalog.unnest(coalesce(prod.aliases, '{}'::text[])) as alias_row(alias_name)
            where pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(alias_row.alias_name)) =
              pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(o.product_list, '')))
          )
        )
      having count(*) = 1
    ) mapped on true
    where o.customer_id = p_customer_id
      and (
        coalesce(o.date_create, o.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
          at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
      )::date <= v_as_of

    union all

    select
      'org_organization_product',
      op.id,
      null::bigint,
      op.id,
      op.product_package_id,
      op.product_id,
      prod.code,
      coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(op.product_name), ''), prod.name),
      coalesce(
        nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(op.package_name), ''),
        nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(op.package_type), '')
      ),
      coalesce(op.purchase_date, op.trial_start_date, op.created_at),
      (op.expiration_date at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date,
      (
        pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(op.package_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(op.package_type, '')) ~
          '(lifetime|forever|unlimited|trọn đời|tron doi|vĩnh viễn|vinh vien)'
        or pg_catalog.date_part('year', op.expiration_date) >= 2090
        or coalesce(op.duration_days, 0) >= 1500
      ),
      (
        not coalesce(op.is_paid, false)
        or pg_catalog.lower(
          coalesce(op.package_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(op.package_type, '')
        ) ~
          '(demo|trial|free|dùng[[:space:]_-]*thử|dung[[:space:]_-]*thu|miễn[[:space:]_-]*phí|mien[[:space:]_-]*phi)'
      ),
      (
        coalesce(op.is_paid, false)
        and not (
          pg_catalog.lower(
            coalesce(op.package_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(op.package_type, '')
          ) ~
            '(demo|trial|free|dùng[[:space:]_-]*thử|dung[[:space:]_-]*thu|miễn[[:space:]_-]*phí|mien[[:space:]_-]*phi)'
        )
      ),
      (not coalesce(op.is_deleted, false) and not coalesce(op.is_lock, false)),
      op.expiration_date is null,
      coalesce(op.updated_at, op.purchase_date, op.trial_start_date, op.created_at)
    from public.org_organization org
    join public.org_organization_product op on op.organization_id = org.id
    left join public.org_product prod on prod.id = op.product_id
    where org.customer_id = p_customer_id
      and (
        coalesce(op.purchase_date, op.trial_start_date, op.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
          at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
      )::date <= v_as_of
  ),
  entitlement as (
    select
      b.*,
      (
        b.source_enabled
        and (b.is_lifetime or (b.expires_on is not null and b.expires_on >= v_as_of))
      ) as is_active,
      (
        (b.source_enabled and b.expiration_missing and not b.is_lifetime)
        or (
          not b.source_enabled
          and (
            (b.expiration_missing and not b.is_lifetime)
            or (b.expires_on is not null and b.expires_on >= v_as_of)
          )
        )
      ) as is_unknown,
      case when b.expires_on is null then null else b.expires_on - v_as_of end as days_left
    from entitlement_base b
  ),
  entitlement_watermark as (
    select max(coalesce(e.source_updated_at, e.starts_at)) as updated_at
    from entitlement e
  ),
  payment_event as (
    select
      'aka_sale_order'::text as source,
      so.id,
      pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(so.status, '')) as status,
      coalesce(so.paid_at, so.updated_at, so.created_at) as event_at,
      so.upgraded_at
    from public.aka_sale_order so
    where so.customer_id = p_customer_id
      and pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(so.status, '')) in (
        'paid', 'completed', 'pending', 'processing', 'confirmed',
        'success', 'upgrade_failed'
      )
      and coalesce(so.paid_at, so.updated_at, so.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
          < ((v_as_of + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')

    union all

    select
      'aka_payment_order',
      po.id,
      pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(po.status, '')),
      coalesce(po.paid_at, po.updated_at, po.created_at),
      po.upgraded_at
    from public.aka_payment_order po
    where po.customer_id = p_customer_id
      and pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(po.status, '')) in (
        'paid', 'completed', 'pending', 'processing', 'confirmed',
        'success', 'upgrade_failed'
      )
      and coalesce(po.paid_at, po.updated_at, po.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
          < ((v_as_of + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
  ),
  payment_state as (
    select
      count(p.id)::integer as history_count,
      count(*) filter (
        where p.event_at is not null
          and p.upgraded_at is null
          and (
            w.updated_at is null
            or p.event_at > w.updated_at
          )
      )::integer as pending_count,
      max(p.event_at) filter (
        where p.event_at is not null
          and p.upgraded_at is null
          and (
            w.updated_at is null
            or p.event_at > w.updated_at
          )
      ) as latest_pending_at
    from entitlement_watermark w
    left join payment_event p on true
  ),
  stats_base as (
    select
      count(*)::integer as history_count,
      count(*) filter (where is_active)::integer as active_count,
      count(*) filter (
        where is_active and days_left between 0 and 15
      )::integer as near_expiry_count,
      count(*) filter (where is_unknown)::integer as unknown_count,
      coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(is_paid), false) as has_paid_history,
      coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(is_demo), false) as has_demo_history
    from entitlement
  ),
  stats as (
    select
      s.*,
      s.unknown_count as entitlement_unknown_count,
      p.pending_count as payment_pending_count,
      p.history_count as payment_history_count,
      p.pending_count > 0 as payment_sync_pending,
      s.history_count = 0 and p.history_count > 0 as payment_history_without_entitlement,
      p.latest_pending_at,
      s.unknown_count
        + p.pending_count
        + case
            when s.history_count = 0 and p.history_count > 0 and p.pending_count = 0
            then 1
            else 0
          end as combined_unknown_count
    from stats_base s
    cross join payment_state p
  ),
  classified as (
    select
      s.*,
      case
        -- Any incomplete/contradictory entitlement or payment sync wins over
        -- an apparently active entitlement.  This is intentionally fail-closed.
        when s.combined_unknown_count > 0 then 'state_unknown'
        when s.near_expiry_count > 0 then 'active_near_expiry'
        when s.active_count > 0 then 'active_other'
        when s.history_count > 0 then 'expired_used'
        else 'never_purchased'
      end as status
    from stats s
  ),
  selected as (
    select e.*
    from entitlement e
    cross join classified c
    where
      (c.status = 'active_near_expiry' and e.is_active and e.days_left between 0 and 15)
      or (
        c.status = 'active_other'
        and e.is_active
        and (e.days_left is null or e.days_left not between 0 and 15)
      )
      or (c.status = 'state_unknown' and e.is_unknown)
      or (c.status = 'expired_used' and not e.is_active and not e.is_unknown)
    order by
      case when c.status = 'active_near_expiry' then e.expires_on end asc nulls last,
      case when c.status = 'active_other' then e.expires_on end asc nulls last,
      case when c.status = 'expired_used' then e.expires_on end desc nulls last,
      e.starts_at desc nulls last,
      e.id desc
    limit 1
  )
  select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'status', c.status,
    'as_of_date_vn', v_as_of,
    'has_history', c.history_count > 0,
    'history_count', c.history_count,
    'active_count', c.active_count,
    'near_expiry_count', c.near_expiry_count,
    'unknown_count', c.combined_unknown_count,
    'entitlement_unknown_count', c.entitlement_unknown_count,
    'payment_sync_pending', c.payment_sync_pending,
    'payment_pending_count', c.payment_pending_count,
    'payment_history_count', c.payment_history_count,
    'payment_history_without_entitlement', c.payment_history_without_entitlement,
    'latest_payment_pending_at', c.latest_pending_at,
    'days_left', s.days_left,
    'has_paid_history', c.has_paid_history,
    'has_demo_history', c.has_demo_history,
    'selected_entitlement', case when s.id is null then null else
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'source', s.source,
        'id', s.id,
        'order_id', s.order_id,
        'organization_product_id', s.organization_product_id,
        'product_package_id', s.product_package_id,
        'product_id', s.product_id,
        'product_code', s.product_code,
        'product_name', s.product_name,
        'package_name', s.package_name,
        'starts_at', s.starts_at,
        'expires_on', s.expires_on,
        'days_left', s.days_left,
        'is_paid', s.is_paid,
        'is_demo', s.is_demo,
        'is_lifetime', s.is_lifetime
      )
    end
  ) into v_result
  from classified c
  left join selected s on true;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.birthday_greeting_echo_v1(p_birthday_gom_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with gom as (
    select g.id, g.shop_id, g.contact_id, g.conversation_id,
           g.reply_content, g.sent_at
    from public.message_gom g
    where g.id = p_birthday_gom_id
      and g.send_status = 'sent'
      and g.sent_at is not null
      and nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(g.reply_content), '') is not null
  ), matched as (
    select m.id, coalesce(m.msg_id, m.message_id, m.cli_msg_id) as external_id,
           coalesce(m.date_action, m.created_at) as sent_at
    from gom g
    join public.messages m on m.gom_id = g.id
    where m.shop_id = g.shop_id
      and m.source = 'pancake'
      and m.webhook_superseded_at is null
      and g.conversation_id is not null
      and m.conversion_id = g.conversation_id
      and (g.contact_id is null or m.contact_id = g.contact_id::text)
      and m.sender_type = 'ADMIN'
      and not coalesce(m.is_undo, false)
      and not coalesce(m.is_hidden, false)
      and nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(m.content), '') = nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(g.reply_content), '')
      and coalesce(m.date_action, m.created_at)
          between g.sent_at - interval '2 minutes' and g.sent_at + interval '30 minutes'
    order by coalesce(m.date_action, m.created_at), m.id
    limit 1
  )
  select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'confirmed', exists(select 1 from matched),
    'message_id', (select id from matched),
    'external_message_id', (select external_id from matched),
    'sent_at', (select sent_at from matched)
  );
$function$
