CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.birthday_offer_allowed_promotions_v1(p_lifecycle jsonb, p_checked_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with selected as (
    select
      p_lifecycle ->> 'status' as lifecycle_status,
      nullif(p_lifecycle #>> '{selected_entitlement,product_package_id}', '')::bigint as product_package_id,
      nullif(p_lifecycle #>> '{selected_entitlement,product_id}', '')::bigint as product_id,
      pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(p_lifecycle #>> '{selected_entitlement,product_code}', ''))) as product_code,
      pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(p_lifecycle #>> '{selected_entitlement,product_name}', ''))) as product_name,
      pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(p_lifecycle #>> '{selected_entitlement,package_name}', ''))) as package_name
  ), workflow as (
    select coalesce(
      u.request_options #> '{workflow,allowed_promotion_ids}',
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) as allowed_promotion_ids
    from public.ai_using u
    where u.code = 'birthday_offer_analyze_v1'
      and u.is_active
    order by u.id
    limit 1
  ), eligible_base as (
    select p.*,
      s.product_id as selected_product_id,
      s.product_code as selected_product_code,
      s.product_name as selected_product_name,
      case
        when p.org_product_package_id is not null then 'org_product_package_id'
        when p.org_product_id is not null then 'org_product_id'
        when nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.sql_product_code), '') is not null then 'sql_product_code'
        when p.sql_package_id is not null then 'sql_package_id'
        when nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_product_name), '') is not null then 'target_product_name'
        else 'target_package_name'
      end as match_kind,
      case
        when p.org_product_package_id is not null then 'org_product_package:' || p.org_product_package_id::text
        when p.org_product_id is not null then 'org_product:' || p.org_product_id::text
        when nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.sql_product_code), '') is not null
          then 'sql_product:' || pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(p.sql_product_code))
        when p.sql_package_id is not null then 'sql_package:' || p.sql_package_id::text
        when nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_product_name), '') is not null
          then 'target_product:' || pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_product_name))
        else 'target_package:' || pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_package_name))
      end as match_key,
      coalesce(
        nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_package_name), ''),
        nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_product_name), ''),
        nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.sql_product_code), ''),
        p.name
      ) as match_name
    from public.aka_promotion p
    cross join selected s
    cross join workflow w
    where p.is_active
      -- Only promotions explicitly approved for this workflow are eligible.
      -- The default empty array keeps all customer-facing sends fail-closed.
      and pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(w.allowed_promotion_ids) = 'array'
      and w.allowed_promotion_ids @> pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(p.id)
      and (p.starts_at is null or p.starts_at <= p_checked_at)
      and (p.ends_at is null or p.ends_at >= p_checked_at)
      and (
        (
          s.lifecycle_status = 'never_purchased'
          and pg_catalog.lower(p.purchase_scope) in (
            'both', 'all', 'new', 'new_purchase', 'mua_moi', 'mua mới'
          )
        )
        or
        (s.lifecycle_status = 'expired_used'
          and (s.product_id is not null or s.product_code <> '')
          and pg_catalog.lower(p.purchase_scope) in (
            'both', 'all', 'renew', 'renewal', 'gia_han', 'gia hạn'
          )
          and (
            (p.org_product_package_id is not null and p.org_product_package_id = s.product_package_id)
            or (p.org_product_id is not null and p.org_product_id = s.product_id)
            or (
              nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.sql_product_code), '') is not null
              and s.product_code <> ''
              and pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(p.sql_product_code)) = s.product_code
            )
            or (
              nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_product_name), '') is not null
              and s.product_name <> ''
              and pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_product_name)) = s.product_name
            )
            or (
              nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_package_name), '') is not null
              and s.package_name <> ''
              and pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(p.target_package_name)) = s.package_name
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ), resolved as (
    select e.*,
      coalesce(e.org_product_id, e.selected_product_id, product_by_code.id) as resolved_product_id,
      coalesce(product_direct.code, product_selected.code, product_by_code.code) as resolved_product_code,
      coalesce(product_direct.name, product_selected.name, product_by_code.name) as resolved_product_name
    from eligible_base e
    left join public.org_product product_direct
      on product_direct.id = e.org_product_id and product_direct.is_active
    left join public.org_product product_selected
      on product_selected.id = e.selected_product_id and product_selected.is_active
    left join public.org_product product_by_code
      on product_by_code.is_active
     and pg_catalog.lower(product_by_code.code) =
         pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(e.sql_product_code, '')))
  ), eligible as (
    select r.*
    from resolved r
    where r.resolved_product_id is not null
  )
  select coalesce(
    pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'id', e.id,
        'name', e.name,
        'description', e.description,
        'discount_type', e.discount_type,
        'discount_value', e.discount_value,
        'bonus_days', e.bonus_days,
        'starts_at', e.starts_at,
        'ends_at', e.ends_at,
        'valid_until', e.ends_at,
        'purchase_scope', e.purchase_scope,
        'match_kind', e.match_kind,
        'match_key', e.match_key,
        'match_name', e.match_name,
        'product_id', e.resolved_product_id,
        'product_code', e.resolved_product_code,
        'product_name', e.resolved_product_name,
        'package_id', coalesce(e.org_product_package_id, e.sql_package_id),
        'package_name', e.target_package_name
      ) order by e.ends_at nulls last, e.id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  from eligible e;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_birthday_offer_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_config private.birthday_offer_config%rowtype;
  v_identity jsonb;
  v_customer_id bigint;
  v_birthday_date date;
begin
  if old.send_status is not distinct from 'sent'
     or new.send_status is distinct from 'sent'
     or new.sent_at is null
     or nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(new.reply_content), '') is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  if not (
    new.bot_intent = 'E5_BIRTHDAY'
    or pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(new.ai_intent, ''))) in ('sinh nhật', 'thông báo sinh nhật')
    or pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(new.intent, ''))) in ('sinh nhật', 'thông báo sinh nhật')
    or (
      pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(new.question_content, '')) like '%sinh nhật của%'
      and pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(new.question_content, '')) like '%hãy gửi lời chúc tốt đẹp%'
    )
  ) then
    return new;
  end if;

  select c.* into v_config
  from private.birthday_offer_config c
  where c.singleton;

  if not found or not v_config.enqueue_enabled then
    return new;
  end if;

  v_identity := private.resolve_birthday_customer_v1(new.id);
  v_customer_id := case
    when v_identity ->> 'status' = 'resolved'
    then (v_identity ->> 'customer_id')::bigint
    else null
  end;
  v_birthday_date := (new.sent_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date;

  insert into private.birthday_offer_jobs (
    birthday_gom_id,
    birthday_date_vn,
    greeting_sent_at,
    transcript_cutoff,
    shop_id,
    contact_id,
    conversation_id,
    delivery_snapshot,
    identity_status,
    customer_id,
    identity_snapshot,
    dry_run,
    max_attempts,
    max_reconcile_attempts,
    next_attempt_at
  ) values (
    new.id,
    v_birthday_date,
    new.sent_at,
    coalesce(new.question_first_at, new.created_at, new.sent_at),
    new.shop_id,
    new.contact_id,
    new.conversation_id,
    coalesce(v_identity -> 'delivery', '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(v_identity ->> 'status', 'unresolved'),
    v_customer_id,
    v_identity - 'delivery',
    v_config.dry_run,
    v_config.max_attempts,
    v_config.max_reconcile_attempts,
    pg_catalog.now() + interval '10 seconds'
  )
  on conflict do nothing;

  return new;
exception
  when others then
    -- Sending the birthday greeting already succeeded. Queue bookkeeping must
    -- never roll that transaction back; leave an operational warning instead.
    raise warning 'birthday_offer_enqueue_failed gom_id=% sqlstate=%', new.id, sqlstate;
    return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.birthday_offer_transcript_rows_v1(p_birthday_gom_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(seq integer, message_id uuid, external_message_id text, role text, sender_type text, content text, sent_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with gom as (
    select g.shop_id, g.contact_id, g.conversation_id,
           coalesce(g.question_first_at, g.created_at, g.sent_at) as transcript_cutoff
    from public.message_gom g
    where g.id = p_birthday_gom_id
      and g.send_status = 'sent'
      and g.sent_at is not null
  ), recent_desc as (
    select
      m.id,
      coalesce(m.msg_id, m.message_id, m.cli_msg_id) as external_id,
      m.sender_type,
      pg_catalog.left(pg_catalog.btrim(m.content), 800) as clean_content,
      coalesce(m.date_action, m.created_at) as event_at
    from gom g
    join public.messages m
      on m.shop_id = g.shop_id
     and (g.contact_id is null or m.contact_id = g.contact_id::text)
     and (g.conversation_id is null or m.conversion_id = g.conversation_id)
     and (g.contact_id is not null or g.conversation_id is not null)
    where m.sender_type in ('CUSTOMER', 'ADMIN')
      and m.source = 'pancake'
      and m.webhook_superseded_at is null
      and not coalesce(m.is_undo, false)
      and not coalesce(m.is_hidden, false)
      and nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(m.content), '') is not null
      and coalesce(m.date_action, m.created_at) < g.transcript_cutoff
      and not (
        pg_catalog.lower(m.content) like '%sinh nhật của%hãy gửi lời chúc tốt đẹp%'
        or pg_catalog.lower(m.content) like '%lời mời kết bạn%'
        or pg_catalog.lower(m.content) like '%cuộc gọi nhỡ%'
        or pg_catalog.lower(m.content) like '%missed call%'
        or pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(m.content)) in (
          '[sticker]', 'sticker', '[image]', '[video]', '[file]'
        )
      )
    order by coalesce(m.date_action, m.created_at) desc, m.id desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 1), 30)
  ), ordered as (
    select *
    from recent_desc
    order by event_at, id
  )
  select
    pg_catalog.row_number() over (order by o.event_at, o.id)::integer as seq,
    o.id,
    o.external_id,
    case when o.sender_type = 'CUSTOMER' then 'customer' else 'staff' end,
    o.sender_type,
    o.clean_content,
    o.event_at
  from ordered o
  order by seq;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.cskh_type23_guard_message_blocker(p_customer_id bigint, p_anchor_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(message_id uuid, message_at timestamp with time zone, skip_reason text, candidate_customer_ids bigint[], identity_sources text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with target as materialized (
  select c.id, public.normalize_phone(c.phone) as normalized_phone
  from public.aka_customer c
  where c.id = p_customer_id
), unique_target_phone as materialized (
  select t.normalized_phone
  from target t
  where t.normalized_phone is not null
    and pg_catalog.length(t.normalized_phone) >= 9
    and (
      select pg_catalog.count(*)
      from public.aka_customer c
      where public.normalize_phone(c.phone) = t.normalized_phone
    ) = 1
), direct_contacts as materialized (
  select c.id
  from public.contacts c
  where c.customer_id = p_customer_id
    and not coalesce(c.is_group, false)
), phone_contacts as materialized (
  select c.id
  from unique_target_phone t
  join public.contacts c
    on c.search_text ilike '%' || pg_catalog.right(t.normalized_phone, 9) || '%'
   and (
     public.normalize_phone(c.phone) = t.normalized_phone
     or exists (
       select 1
       from pg_catalog.unnest(coalesce(c.phone_list, '{}'::text[])) p(phone)
       where public.normalize_phone(p.phone) = t.normalized_phone
     )
   )
  where not coalesce(c.is_group, false)
), target_contacts as materialized (
  select id from direct_contacts
  union
  select id from phone_contacts
), target_goms as materialized (
  select g.id
  from public.message_gom g
  left join public.contacts c on c.id = g.contact_id
  where g.aka_customer_id = p_customer_id
    and not coalesce(c.is_group, false)

  union

  select g.id
  from target_contacts c
  join public.message_gom g on g.contact_id = c.id
), seed_messages as materialized (
  select
    m.id,
    m.date_action,
    m.akacustomer_id,
    m.contact_id,
    m.gom_id,
    m.sender_type,
    m.is_group,
    m.is_undo,
    m.is_hidden,
    m.webhook_superseded_at,
    m.type,
    m.sending_status
  from public.messages m
  where m.akacustomer_id = p_customer_id

  union all

  select
    m.id,
    m.date_action,
    m.akacustomer_id,
    m.contact_id,
    m.gom_id,
    m.sender_type,
    m.is_group,
    m.is_undo,
    m.is_hidden,
    m.webhook_superseded_at,
    m.type,
    m.sending_status
  from target_contacts c
  join public.messages m on m.contact_id = c.id::text

  union all

  select
    m.id,
    m.date_action,
    m.akacustomer_id,
    m.contact_id,
    m.gom_id,
    m.sender_type,
    m.is_group,
    m.is_undo,
    m.is_hidden,
    m.webhook_superseded_at,
    m.type,
    m.sending_status
  from target_goms g
  join public.messages m on m.gom_id = g.id
), candidate_messages as materialized (
  select distinct
    s.id,
    s.date_action as event_at,
    s.akacustomer_id,
    s.contact_id,
    s.gom_id
  from seed_messages s
  where s.sender_type in ('CUSTOMER', 'ADMIN')
    and not coalesce(s.is_group, false)
    and not coalesce(s.is_undo, false)
    and not coalesce(s.is_hidden, false)
    and s.webhook_superseded_at is null
    and s.type is distinct from 'event'
    and s.sending_status is distinct from 'error'
    and s.date_action between p_anchor_at - interval '72 hours'
                          and p_anchor_at + interval '72 hours'
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.contacts c
      where c.is_group = true
        and (
          c.id = case
            when s.contact_id ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
              then s.contact_id::uuid
            else null
          end
          or c.id = (
            select g.contact_id
            from public.message_gom g
            where g.id = s.gom_id
          )
        )
    )
), identities as materialized (
  select
    m.id as message_id,
    m.akacustomer_id as customer_id,
    'messages.akacustomer_id'::text as source
  from candidate_messages m
  where m.akacustomer_id is not null

  union all

  select m.id, c.customer_id, 'contacts.customer_id'
  from candidate_messages m
  join public.contacts c on c.id = case
    when m.contact_id ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      then m.contact_id::uuid
    else null
  end
  where c.customer_id is not null

  union all

  select m.id, g.aka_customer_id, 'message_gom.aka_customer_id'
  from candidate_messages m
  join public.message_gom g on g.id = m.gom_id
  where g.aka_customer_id is not null

  union all

  select m.id, c.customer_id, 'message_gom.contact_id'
  from candidate_messages m
  join public.message_gom g on g.id = m.gom_id
  join public.contacts c on c.id = g.contact_id
  where c.customer_id is not null

  union all

  select m.id, p_customer_id, 'contacts.unique_phone'
  from candidate_messages m
  join phone_contacts pc on pc.id = case
    when m.contact_id ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      then m.contact_id::uuid
    else null
  end

  union all

  select m.id, p_customer_id, 'message_gom.contact_unique_phone'
  from candidate_messages m
  join public.message_gom g on g.id = m.gom_id
  join phone_contacts pc on pc.id = g.contact_id
), resolved as (
  select
    m.id,
    m.event_at,
    pg_catalog.array_agg(distinct i.customer_id order by i.customer_id) as customer_ids,
    pg_catalog.array_agg(distinct i.source order by i.source) as sources
  from candidate_messages m
  join identities i on i.message_id = m.id
  group by m.id, m.event_at
  having pg_catalog.bool_or(i.customer_id = p_customer_id)
)
select
  r.id,
  r.event_at,
  case when pg_catalog.cardinality(r.customer_ids) > 1
    then 'identity_conflict_recent_message'
    else 'message_within_3d'
  end,
  r.customer_ids,
  r.sources
from resolved r
order by
  case when pg_catalog.cardinality(r.customer_ids) > 1 then 0 else 1 end,
  r.event_at desc,
  r.id desc
limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reconcile_org_product_loyalty(p_customer_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_customer_id is null or p_customer_id <= 0 then
    return;
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
      'private.refresh_customer_loyalty_snapshot:' || p_customer_id::text,
      0
    )
  );

  with product_occurrences as (
    select
      organization.customer_id,
      product.product_id,
      product.id as source_product_id,
      coalesce(
        product.purchase_date,
        product.first_sale_at,
        product.created_at
      ) as occurred_at,
      case
        when product.purchase_date is not null
          or product.first_sale_at is not null then 'exact'
        else 'derived'
      end as date_quality,
      pg_catalog.row_number() over (
        partition by organization.customer_id, product.product_id
        order by
          coalesce(
            product.purchase_date,
            product.first_sale_at,
            product.created_at
          ),
          product.id
      ) as same_product_rank
    from public.org_organization_product as product
    join public.org_organization as organization
      on organization.id = product.organization_id
    where organization.customer_id = p_customer_id
      and product.product_id is not null
      and product.is_paid is true
      and product.is_deleted is false
  ),
  distinct_products as (
    select *
    from product_occurrences
    where same_product_rank = 1
  ),
  ranked_products as (
    select
      distinct_products.*,
      pg_catalog.row_number() over (
        partition by customer_id
        order by occurred_at, source_product_id, product_id
      ) as customer_product_rank
    from distinct_products
  )
  insert into public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event (
    customer_id,
    loyalty_type,
    occurred_at,
    date_quality,
    source_system,
    source_table,
    source_record_id,
    source_event_key,
    source_payload
  )
  select
    ranked.customer_id,
    'additional_product',
    ranked.occurred_at,
    ranked.date_quality,
    'org_product',
    'org_organization_product',
    ranked.source_product_id::text,
    'org_product_customer:' || ranked.customer_id::text
      || ':product:' || ranked.product_id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'org_organization_product_id', ranked.source_product_id,
      'product_id', ranked.product_id
    )
  from ranked_products as ranked
  where ranked.customer_product_rank > 1
  on conflict (source_event_key) do update
  set
    customer_id = excluded.customer_id,
    occurred_at = excluded.occurred_at,
    date_quality = excluded.date_quality,
    source_table = excluded.source_table,
    source_record_id = excluded.source_record_id,
    source_payload = excluded.source_payload,
    invalidated_at = null,
    updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp();

  with current_additional_keys as (
    select
      'org_product_customer:' || ranked.customer_id::text
        || ':product:' || ranked.product_id::text as source_event_key
    from (
      select
        distinct_product.*,
        pg_catalog.row_number() over (
          partition by distinct_product.customer_id
          order by
            distinct_product.occurred_at,
            distinct_product.source_product_id,
            distinct_product.product_id
        ) as customer_product_rank
      from (
        select *
        from (
          select
            organization.customer_id,
            product.product_id,
            product.id as source_product_id,
            coalesce(
              product.purchase_date,
              product.first_sale_at,
              product.created_at
            ) as occurred_at,
            pg_catalog.row_number() over (
              partition by organization.customer_id, product.product_id
              order by
                coalesce(
                  product.purchase_date,
                  product.first_sale_at,
                  product.created_at
                ),
                product.id
            ) as same_product_rank
          from public.org_organization_product as product
          join public.org_organization as organization
            on organization.id = product.organization_id
          where organization.customer_id = p_customer_id
            and product.product_id is not null
            and product.is_paid is true
            and product.is_deleted is false
        ) as occurrences
        where occurrences.same_product_rank = 1
      ) as distinct_product
    ) as ranked
    where ranked.customer_product_rank > 1
  )
  update public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event
  set
    invalidated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp(),
    updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  where event.customer_id = p_customer_id
    and event.source_system = 'org_product'
    and event.loyalty_type = 'additional_product'
    and event.invalidated_at is null
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from current_additional_keys as current_key
      where current_key.source_event_key = event.source_event_key
    );

  insert into public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event (
    customer_id,
    loyalty_type,
    occurred_at,
    date_quality,
    source_system,
    source_table,
    source_record_id,
    source_event_key,
    source_payload
  )
  select
    organization.customer_id,
    'lifetime_package',
    coalesce(
      product.purchase_date,
      product.first_sale_at,
      product.created_at
    ),
    case
      when product.purchase_date is not null
        or product.first_sale_at is not null then 'exact'
      else 'derived'
    end,
    'org_product',
    'org_organization_product',
    product.id::text,
    'org_product:' || product.id::text || ':lifetime',
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'org_organization_product_id', product.id,
      'product_id', product.product_id,
      'product_package_id', product.product_package_id,
      'package_type', coalesce(
        product.package_type,
        package.package_type
      )
    )
  from public.org_organization_product as product
  join public.org_organization as organization
    on organization.id = product.organization_id
  left join public.org_product_package as package
    on package.id = product.product_package_id
  where organization.customer_id = p_customer_id
    and product.is_paid is true
    and product.is_deleted is false
    and pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(
      product.package_type,
      package.package_type,
      ''
    )) = 'unlimited'
  on conflict (source_event_key) do update
  set
    customer_id = excluded.customer_id,
    occurred_at = excluded.occurred_at,
    date_quality = excluded.date_quality,
    source_table = excluded.source_table,
    source_record_id = excluded.source_record_id,
    source_payload = excluded.source_payload,
    invalidated_at = null,
    updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp();

  update public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event
  set
    invalidated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp(),
    updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  where event.customer_id = p_customer_id
    and event.source_system = 'org_product'
    and event.loyalty_type = 'lifetime_package'
    and event.invalidated_at is null
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.org_organization_product as product
      join public.org_organization as organization
        on organization.id = product.organization_id
      left join public.org_product_package as package
        on package.id = product.product_package_id
      where organization.customer_id = p_customer_id
        and product.is_paid is true
        and product.is_deleted is false
        and pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(
          product.package_type,
          package.package_type,
          ''
        )) = 'unlimited'
        and 'org_product:' || product.id::text || ':lifetime'
          = event.source_event_key
    );

  perform private.refresh_customer_loyalty_snapshot(p_customer_id);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reconcile_sql_account_loyalty(p_customer_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_customer_id is null or p_customer_id <= 0 then
    return;
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
      'private.refresh_customer_loyalty_snapshot:' || p_customer_id::text,
      0
    )
  );

  with product_occurrences as (
    select
      order_row.customer_id,
      product.product_code,
      product.product_ordinal,
      order_row.id as source_order_id,
      order_row.source_record_id,
      coalesce(
        order_row.date_update_package,
        order_row.purchase_date,
        order_row.date_create,
        order_row.created_at
      ) as occurred_at,
      pg_catalog.row_number() over (
        partition by order_row.customer_id, product.product_code
        order by
          coalesce(
            order_row.date_update_package,
            order_row.purchase_date,
            order_row.date_create,
            order_row.created_at
          ),
          order_row.id,
          product.product_ordinal
      ) as same_product_rank
    from public.aka_order as order_row
    cross join lateral private.aka_loyalty_sql_product_codes(
      order_row.product_list
    ) as product
    where order_row.customer_id = p_customer_id
      and order_row.source_system = 'sql_account'
      and order_row.is_paid is true
      and coalesce(order_row.is_deleted, false) is false
  ),
  distinct_products as (
    select *
    from product_occurrences
    where same_product_rank = 1
  ),
  ranked_products as (
    select
      distinct_products.*,
      pg_catalog.row_number() over (
        partition by customer_id
        order by
          occurred_at,
          source_order_id,
          product_ordinal,
          product_code
      ) as customer_product_rank
    from distinct_products
  )
  insert into public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event (
    customer_id,
    loyalty_type,
    occurred_at,
    date_quality,
    source_system,
    source_table,
    source_record_id,
    source_event_key,
    source_payload
  )
  select
    ranked.customer_id,
    'additional_product',
    ranked.occurred_at,
    'derived',
    'sql_account',
    'aka_order',
    ranked.source_order_id::text,
    'sql_product:' || ranked.customer_id::text
      || ':' || ranked.product_code,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'aka_order_id', ranked.source_order_id,
      'source_record_id', ranked.source_record_id,
      'product_code', ranked.product_code
    )
  from ranked_products as ranked
  where ranked.customer_product_rank > 1
  on conflict (source_event_key) do update
  set
    customer_id = excluded.customer_id,
    occurred_at = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact' then event.occurred_at
      else excluded.occurred_at
    end,
    date_quality = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact' then event.date_quality
      else excluded.date_quality
    end,
    source_table = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact' then event.source_table
      else excluded.source_table
    end,
    source_record_id = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact' then event.source_record_id
      else excluded.source_record_id
    end,
    source_payload = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact' then event.source_payload
      else excluded.source_payload
    end,
    invalidated_at = null,
    updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp();

  with current_additional_keys as (
    select
      'sql_product:' || ranked.customer_id::text
        || ':' || ranked.product_code as source_event_key
    from (
      select
        distinct_product.*,
        pg_catalog.row_number() over (
          partition by distinct_product.customer_id
          order by
            distinct_product.occurred_at,
            distinct_product.source_order_id,
            distinct_product.product_ordinal,
            distinct_product.product_code
        ) as customer_product_rank
      from (
        select *
        from (
          select
            order_row.customer_id,
            product.product_code,
            product.product_ordinal,
            order_row.id as source_order_id,
            coalesce(
              order_row.date_update_package,
              order_row.purchase_date,
              order_row.date_create,
              order_row.created_at
            ) as occurred_at,
            pg_catalog.row_number() over (
              partition by order_row.customer_id, product.product_code
              order by
                coalesce(
                  order_row.date_update_package,
                  order_row.purchase_date,
                  order_row.date_create,
                  order_row.created_at
                ),
                order_row.id,
                product.product_ordinal
            ) as same_product_rank
          from public.aka_order as order_row
          cross join lateral private.aka_loyalty_sql_product_codes(
            order_row.product_list
          ) as product
          where order_row.customer_id = p_customer_id
            and order_row.source_system = 'sql_account'
            and order_row.is_paid is true
            and coalesce(order_row.is_deleted, false) is false
        ) as occurrences
        where occurrences.same_product_rank = 1
      ) as distinct_product
    ) as ranked
    where ranked.customer_product_rank > 1
  )
  update public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event
  set
    invalidated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp(),
    updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  where event.customer_id = p_customer_id
    and event.source_system = 'sql_account'
    and event.loyalty_type = 'additional_product'
    and event.invalidated_at is null
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from current_additional_keys as current_key
      where current_key.source_event_key = event.source_event_key
    );

  insert into public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event (
    customer_id,
    loyalty_type,
    occurred_at,
    date_quality,
    source_system,
    source_table,
    source_record_id,
    source_event_key,
    source_payload
  )
  select
    order_row.customer_id,
    'lifetime_package',
    coalesce(
      order_row.purchase_date,
      order_row.date_update_package,
      order_row.date_create,
      order_row.created_at
    ),
    case
      when order_row.purchase_date is not null then 'exact'
      else 'derived'
    end,
    'sql_account',
    'aka_order',
    order_row.id::text,
    'aka_order:sql_account:' || order_row.id::text || ':lifetime',
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'aka_order_id', order_row.id,
      'source_record_id', order_row.source_record_id,
      'package', order_row.package,
      'package_type', order_row.package_type
    )
  from public.aka_order as order_row
  where order_row.customer_id = p_customer_id
    and order_row.source_system = 'sql_account'
    and order_row.is_paid is true
    and coalesce(order_row.is_deleted, false) is false
    and pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(
      order_row.package_type,
      order_row.package,
      ''
    )) = 'forever'
  on conflict (source_event_key) do update
  set
    customer_id = excluded.customer_id,
    occurred_at = excluded.occurred_at,
    date_quality = excluded.date_quality,
    source_table = excluded.source_table,
    source_record_id = excluded.source_record_id,
    source_payload = excluded.source_payload,
    invalidated_at = null,
    updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp();

  update public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event
  set
    invalidated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp(),
    updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  where event.customer_id = p_customer_id
    and event.source_system = 'sql_account'
    and event.loyalty_type = 'lifetime_package'
    and event.invalidated_at is null
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.aka_order as order_row
      where order_row.customer_id = p_customer_id
        and order_row.source_system = 'sql_account'
        and order_row.is_paid is true
        and coalesce(order_row.is_deleted, false) is false
        and pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(
          order_row.package_type,
          order_row.package,
          ''
        )) = 'forever'
        and 'aka_order:sql_account:' || order_row.id::text || ':lifetime'
          = event.source_event_key
    );

  perform private.refresh_customer_loyalty_snapshot(p_customer_id);
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.aka_loyalty_sql_product_codes(p_product_list text)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_code text, product_ordinal integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with pieces as (
    select
      pg_catalog.lower(piece.value) as product_code,
      piece.ordinality::integer as product_ordinal
    from pg_catalog.regexp_split_to_table(
      coalesce(p_product_list, ''),
      '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+'
    ) with ordinality as piece(value, ordinality)
  ),
  recognized as (
    select product_code, product_ordinal
    from pieces
    where product_code = any (array[
      'akamap', 'data', 'email', 'facebook', 'fanpageweb',
      'fbextension', 'raovat', 'shopee', 'sms', 'smsmobile',
      'tiktok', 'zalo', 'zaloapi', 'zaloex'
    ]::text[])
  )
  select
    recognized.product_code,
    pg_catalog.min(recognized.product_ordinal)::integer as product_ordinal
  from recognized
  group by recognized.product_code
  order by pg_catalog.min(recognized.product_ordinal), recognized.product_code
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.refresh_customer_loyalty_snapshot(p_customer_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_latest public.aka_customer_loyalty_event%rowtype;
begin
  if p_customer_id is null or p_customer_id <= 0 then
    return;
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
      'private.refresh_customer_loyalty_snapshot:' || p_customer_id::text,
      0
    )
  );

  select event.*
  into v_latest
  from public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event
  where event.customer_id = p_customer_id
    and event.invalidated_at is null
  order by
    event.occurred_at desc,
    (event.date_quality = 'exact') desc,
    event.updated_at desc,
    event.id desc
  limit 1;

  update public.aka_customer as customer
  set
    loyalty_date = case when found then v_latest.occurred_at else null end,
    loyalty_type = case when found then v_latest.loyalty_type else null end
  where customer.id = p_customer_id
    and (customer.loyalty_date, customer.loyalty_type)
      is distinct from (
        case when found then v_latest.occurred_at else null end,
        case when found then v_latest.loyalty_type else null end
      );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.upsert_customer_loyalty_event(p_customer_id bigint, p_loyalty_type text, p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone, p_date_quality text, p_source_system text, p_source_table text, p_source_record_id text, p_source_event_key text, p_source_payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_event_id bigint;
begin
  if p_customer_id is null or p_customer_id <= 0
     or p_occurred_at is null
     or p_source_event_key is null
     or pg_catalog.btrim(p_source_event_key) = '' then
    return null;
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
      'private.refresh_customer_loyalty_snapshot:' || p_customer_id::text,
      0
    )
  );

  insert into public.aka_customer_loyalty_event as event (
    customer_id,
    loyalty_type,
    occurred_at,
    date_quality,
    source_system,
    source_table,
    source_record_id,
    source_event_key,
    source_payload,
    invalidated_at
  ) values (
    p_customer_id,
    p_loyalty_type,
    p_occurred_at,
    p_date_quality,
    p_source_system,
    p_source_table,
    p_source_record_id,
    p_source_event_key,
    coalesce(p_source_payload, '{}'::jsonb),
    null
  )
  on conflict (source_event_key) do update
  set
    customer_id = excluded.customer_id,
    loyalty_type = excluded.loyalty_type,
    occurred_at = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact'
       and excluded.date_quality = 'derived'
        then event.occurred_at
      else excluded.occurred_at
    end,
    date_quality = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact'
       and excluded.date_quality = 'derived'
        then event.date_quality
      else excluded.date_quality
    end,
    source_system = excluded.source_system,
    source_table = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact'
       and excluded.date_quality = 'derived'
        then event.source_table
      else excluded.source_table
    end,
    source_record_id = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact'
       and excluded.date_quality = 'derived'
        then event.source_record_id
      else excluded.source_record_id
    end,
    source_payload = case
      when event.date_quality = 'exact'
       and excluded.date_quality = 'derived'
        then event.source_payload
      else excluded.source_payload
    end,
    invalidated_at = null,
    updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  returning event.id into v_event_id;

  perform private.refresh_customer_loyalty_snapshot(p_customer_id);
  return v_event_id;
end;

      public.aka_order.source_updated_at,
      public.aka_order.source_snapshot
    ) is distinct from (
      excluded.source_record_id,

      );

  );

 RETURNS boolean

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.source_system not in ('sql_account', 'legacy_manual') then
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.source_system = 'sql_account' then
    new.source_record_id := coalesce(
      new.account_id_old,
      new.source_record_id,
      new.id
    );
    -- Runtime write-through, legacy-row claims and the batch RPC share one
    -- source lock, so a missing-row race cannot abort a whole backfill batch.
    perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
      pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
        'aka_order/sql_account/' || new.source_record_id::text,
        0
      )
    );
  else
    new.source_record_id := coalesce(new.source_record_id, new.id);
  end if;

  if pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(new.source_snapshot) is distinct from 'object'
     or new.source_snapshot = '{}'::jsonb then
    new.source_snapshot := private.build_aka_order_safe_source_snapshot(new);
  elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE'
        and new.source_snapshot is not distinct from old.source_snapshot
        and old.source_snapshot ->> 'snapshot_origin' = 'database_fallback'
        and (
          new.source_system,
          new.source_record_id,
          new.account_id_old,
          new.customer_id_old,
          new.customer_id,
          new.name,
          new.phone,
          new.email,
          new.address,
          new.source,
          new.career,
          new.account_type,
          new.account_code,
          new.product_package_id,
          new.package,
          new.product_list,
          new.thanh_tien,
          new.max_staff,
          new.max_shop,
          new.max_sends_per_day,
          new.max_zalo_zm,
          new.max_zalo_extension,
          new.max_facebook_extension,
          new.is_dai_ly_old,
          new.dai_ly_id_old,
          new.dai_ly_code_old,
          new.staff_aff_id_old,
          new.staff_aff_code_old,
          new.source_aff,
          new.date_create,
          new.date_expiration,
          new.date_update_package,
          new.date_first_update,
          new.date_last_update,
          new.staff_create_id_old,
          new.staff_update_id_old,
          new.staff_manage_id_old,
          new.count_update_old,
          new.source_created_at,
          new.source_updated_at,
          new.sql_sync_at
        ) is distinct from (
          old.source_system,
          old.source_record_id,
          old.account_id_old,
          old.customer_id_old,
          old.customer_id,
          old.name,
          old.phone,
          old.email,
          old.address,
          old.source,
          old.career,
          old.account_type,
          old.account_code,
          old.product_package_id,
          old.package,
          old.product_list,
          old.thanh_tien,
          old.max_staff,
          old.max_shop,
          old.max_sends_per_day,
          old.max_zalo_zm,
          old.max_zalo_extension,
          old.max_facebook_extension,
          old.is_dai_ly_old,
          old.dai_ly_id_old,
          old.dai_ly_code_old,
          old.staff_aff_id_old,
          old.staff_aff_code_old,
          old.source_aff,
          old.date_create,
          old.date_expiration,
          old.date_update_package,
          old.date_first_update,
          old.date_last_update,
          old.staff_create_id_old,
          old.staff_update_id_old,
          old.staff_manage_id_old,
          old.count_update_old,
          old.source_created_at,
          old.source_updated_at,
          old.sql_sync_at
        ) then
    new.source_snapshot := private.build_aka_order_safe_source_snapshot(new);
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'UPDATE'
     and new.sync_version is not distinct from old.sync_version
     and (
       new.source_snapshot is distinct from old.source_snapshot
       or private.build_aka_order_safe_source_snapshot(new)
          is distinct from private.build_aka_order_safe_source_snapshot(old)
     ) then
    new.sync_version := old.sync_version + 1;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.refresh_aka_customer_order_aggregate(p_customer_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_total integer;
  v_paid integer;
  v_package text;
  v_expiry timestamptz;
begin
  if p_customer_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  select
    count(*) filter (where is_deleted is not true),
    count(*) filter (
      where is_deleted is not true
        and case
        when source_system = 'org_product' then is_paid is true
        else package not in ('demo', 'free') and package is not null
      end
    ),
    (
      select candidate.package
      from public.aka_order as candidate
      where candidate.customer_id = p_customer_id
        and candidate.is_deleted is not true
      order by
        case
          when candidate.source_system = 'org_product'
            and candidate.order_status in (
              'demo_active',
              'paid_active',
              'unpaid_active'
            ) then 0
          when candidate.source_system <> 'org_product'
            and candidate.is_active is true then 0
          else 1
        end,
        coalesce(
          candidate.date_update_package,
          candidate.date_create,
          candidate.created_at
        ) desc nulls last,
        candidate.id desc
      limit 1
    ),
    max(date_expiration) filter (where is_deleted is not true)
  into v_total, v_paid, v_package, v_expiry
  from public.aka_order
  where customer_id = p_customer_id;

  update public.aka_customer
  set
    total_orders = v_total,
    total_paid_orders = v_paid,
    current_package = v_package,
    package_expiry_date = v_expiry
  where id = p_customer_id
    and (
      total_orders,
      total_paid_orders,
      current_package,
      package_expiry_date
    ) is distinct from (
      v_total,
      v_paid,
      v_package,
      v_expiry
    );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.capture_org_organization_product_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_before_snapshot jsonb;
  v_after_snapshot jsonb := pg_catalog.to_jsonb(new);
  v_changed_fields text[] := '{}'::text[];
  v_actor_org_staff_id bigint;
  v_actor_name text;
  v_actor_username text;
  v_actor_type text;
  v_actor_source text;
  v_auth_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  v_database_role text;
  v_changed_at timestamptz := pg_catalog.statement_timestamp();
begin
  v_database_role := coalesce(
    nullif(
      pg_catalog.current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true),
      ''
    ),
    nullif(
      pg_catalog.current_setting('role', true),
      'none'
    ),
    session_user::text
  );

  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    select coalesce(
      pg_catalog.array_agg(source_key.key order by source_key.key),
      '{}'::text[]
    )
    into v_changed_fields
    from pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(v_after_snapshot) as source_key(key);

    v_actor_org_staff_id := new.created_by;
    v_actor_source := case
      when v_actor_org_staff_id is not null then 'created_by'
      when v_auth_user_id is not null then 'auth_uid'
      else 'database_role'
    end;
  else
    v_before_snapshot := pg_catalog.to_jsonb(old);

    select coalesce(
      pg_catalog.array_agg(source_key.key order by source_key.key),
      '{}'::text[]
    )
    into v_changed_fields
    from pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(v_after_snapshot) as source_key(key)
    where v_before_snapshot -> source_key.key
          is distinct from
          v_after_snapshot -> source_key.key;

    -- updated_by is the business contract used by every supported application
    -- and RPC write path. Do not fall back to OLD.updated_by or created_by.
    v_actor_org_staff_id := new.updated_by;
    v_actor_source := case
      when v_actor_org_staff_id is not null then 'updated_by'
      when v_auth_user_id is not null then 'auth_uid'
      else 'database_role'
    end;
  end if;

  if v_actor_org_staff_id is not null then
    select
      nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(staff.name), ''),
      nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(staff.username), '')
    into v_actor_name, v_actor_username
    from public.org_staff as staff
    where staff.id = v_actor_org_staff_id;

    if found then
      v_actor_type := 'org_staff';
    else
      v_actor_type := 'unknown';
      v_actor_source := v_actor_source || '_missing_staff';
    end if;
  elsif v_auth_user_id is not null then
    v_actor_type := 'unknown';
  else
    v_actor_type := 'system';
  end if;

  insert into public.org_organization_product_history (
    organization_id,
    product_package_id,
    product_id,
    product_name,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stop_invalid_staff_group_sources()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_group bigint; v_source record;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.organization_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id
    AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.deleted_at
    AND NEW.is_active IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_active THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  FOR v_group IN SELECT DISTINCT g.id FROM public.auto_account_contact_groups g
    JOIN public.auto_campaign_data_group_sources s ON s.group_id=g.id
    WHERE s.staff_id<>g.staff_id AND (g.staff_id=NEW.id OR s.staff_id=NEW.id)
      AND s.status IN ('active','baselining') ORDER BY g.id
  LOOP
    PERFORM id FROM public.auto_account_contact_groups WHERE id=v_group FOR UPDATE;
    FOR v_source IN SELECT s.id,s.campaign_id FROM public.auto_campaign_data_group_sources s
      JOIN public.auto_account_contact_groups g ON g.id=s.group_id
      WHERE s.group_id=v_group AND s.staff_id<>g.staff_id AND s.status IN ('active','baselining')
        AND NOT private.can_read_data_group(g.id,s.staff_id,s.organization_id)
      ORDER BY s.campaign_id,s.id
    LOOP
      PERFORM public.aka_agent_lock_campaign_input_serialization(v_source.campaign_id);
      UPDATE public.auto_campaign_data_group_sources SET status='stopped',stop_reason='sharing_revoked',stopped_at=now(),updated_at=now()
        WHERE id=v_source.id AND status IN ('active','baselining');
    END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.group_access(p_kind text, p_group_id bigint, p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH resource AS (
    SELECT id,staff_id,organization_id,sharing_scope,sharing_revision
    FROM public.auto_account_contact_groups
    WHERE p_kind='data' AND id=p_group_id AND purpose='data_group' AND NOT is_delete
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id,staff_id,organization_id,sharing_scope,sharing_revision
    FROM public.auto_content_groups
    WHERE p_kind='content' AND id=p_group_id AND NOT is_delete
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'ownerStaffId',g.staff_id,'ownerName',COALESCE(NULLIF(owner.name,''),'Nhân viên #'||owner.id),
    'role',CASE WHEN g.staff_id=p_staff_id THEN 'owner' ELSE 'shared' END,
    'canManage',g.staff_id=p_staff_id,'canUse',true,'canCopy',true,
    'scope',g.sharing_scope,'revision',g.sharing_revision::text)
  FROM resource g
  JOIN public.org_staff owner ON owner.id=g.staff_id AND owner.organization_id=g.organization_id
    AND owner.deleted_at IS NULL AND owner.is_active
  JOIN public.org_staff viewer ON viewer.id=p_staff_id AND viewer.organization_id=g.organization_id
    AND viewer.deleted_at IS NULL AND viewer.is_active
  WHERE g.organization_id=p_organization_id AND (
    g.staff_id=p_staff_id OR g.sharing_scope='organization' OR
    (g.sharing_scope='selected' AND (
      (p_kind='data' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.auto_data_group_recipients r WHERE r.group_id=g.id AND r.staff_id=p_staff_id))
      OR (p_kind='content' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.auto_content_group_recipients r WHERE r.group_id=g.id AND r.staff_id=p_staff_id))
    ))
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.list_shared_data_groups(p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint, p_search text, p_compatible_action_id text, p_compatible_data_type_category_item_id bigint, p_data_type_category_item_ids bigint[], p_offset integer, p_limit integer, p_unrestricted_only boolean, p_owned_only boolean)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, name text, color text, sort_order integer, revision bigint, data_type_category_item_id bigint, data_type_code text, data_type_name text, dataset_sync_mode text, active_membership_count bigint, is_delete boolean, staff_id bigint, organization_id bigint, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.aka_agent_internal_require_staff_tenant(
    p_staff_id, p_organization_id
  );
  IF COALESCE(p_offset, 0) < 0
    OR COALESCE(p_limit, 100) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_data_group_page';
  END IF;
  IF p_compatible_data_type_category_item_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT public.aka_agent_is_data_type_category_item(
      p_compatible_data_type_category_item_id, true
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_data_type_category_item';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT contact_group.*
    FROM public.auto_account_contact_groups AS contact_group
    WHERE (NOT p_owned_only OR contact_group.staff_id = p_staff_id)
      AND private.can_read_data_group(contact_group.id,p_staff_id,p_organization_id)
      AND contact_group.organization_id = p_organization_id
      AND contact_group.purpose = 'data_group'
      AND contact_group.is_delete = false
      AND (
        NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search, '')), '') IS NULL
        OR contact_group.name ILIKE '%' || btrim(p_search) || '%'
      )
      AND (
        p_data_type_category_item_ids IS NULL
        OR contact_group.data_type_category_item_id =
          ANY(p_data_type_category_item_ids)
      )
      AND (
        NOT COALESCE(p_unrestricted_only, false)
        OR contact_group.data_type_category_item_id IS NULL
      )
      AND (
        p_compatible_data_type_category_item_id IS NULL
        OR contact_group.data_type_category_item_id IS NULL
        OR contact_group.data_type_category_item_id =
          p_compatible_data_type_category_item_id
      )
      AND (
        NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_compatible_action_id, '')), '') IS NULL
        OR contact_group.data_type_category_item_id IS NULL
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.auto_campaign_action_data_types AS mapping
          WHERE mapping.campaign_action_id =
              btrim(p_compatible_action_id)
            AND mapping.data_type_category_item_id =
              contact_group.data_type_category_item_id
            AND mapping.can_target = true
            AND mapping.is_active = true
            AND mapping.is_delete = false
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    filtered.id,
    filtered.name,
    filtered.color,
    filtered.sort_order,
    filtered.revision,
    filtered.data_type_category_item_id,
    data_type_item.code,
    data_type_item.name,
    filtered.dataset_sync_mode,
    (
      SELECT count(*)
      FROM public.auto_account_contact_group_members AS member
      WHERE member.group_id = filtered.id
        AND member.is_delete = false
    )::bigint,
    filtered.is_delete,
    filtered.staff_id,
    filtered.organization_id,
    filtered.created_at,
    filtered.updated_at,
    count(*) OVER ()::bigint
  FROM filtered
  LEFT JOIN public.category_item AS data_type_item
    ON data_type_item.id = filtered.data_type_category_item_id
  ORDER BY
    filtered.sort_order,
    filtered.updated_at DESC,
    filtered.id DESC
  OFFSET COALESCE(p_offset, 0)
  LIMIT COALESCE(p_limit, 100);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.read_shared_group_members(p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint, p_group_id bigint, p_search text, p_account_ids bigint[], p_include_accountless boolean, p_contact_types text[], p_flatform_types text[], p_status text, p_dataset_ids bigint[], p_data_type_category_item_ids bigint[], p_ids bigint[], p_exclude_ids bigint[], p_offset integer, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET statement_timeout TO '60s'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT to_jsonb(m) || jsonb_build_object('zalo_name',CASE WHEN contact.flatform_type='zalo' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.zalo_name,''),NULLIF(z.zalo_name,''),contact.name) END,'display_name',CASE WHEN contact.flatform_type='zalo' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name,''),NULLIF(u.zalo_name,''),NULLIF(z.display_name,''),NULLIF(z.zalo_name,''),contact.name) END,'zalo_friend_status',CASE WHEN contact.flatform_type='zalo' AND contact.contact_type='person' THEN
        CASE WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN status.code IN ('friend','request_sent','request_received') THEN status.code ELSE 'stranger' END
          WHEN contact.is_friend IS TRUE THEN 'friend'
          WHEN COALESCE(contact.extra_data->>'friendRequestReceived',contact.extra_data->>'friend_request_received','false')='true' THEN 'request_received'
          WHEN COALESCE(contact.extra_data->>'friendRequestSent',contact.extra_data->>'friend_request_sent','false')='true' THEN 'request_sent'
          ELSE 'stranger' END END)
  FROM public.aka_agent_list_data_group_members(p_staff_id,p_organization_id,p_group_id,p_search,p_account_ids,p_include_accountless,p_contact_types,p_flatform_types,p_status,p_dataset_ids,p_data_type_category_item_ids,p_ids,p_exclude_ids,p_offset,p_limit) m
  JOIN public.auto_account_contacts contact ON contact.id=m.contact_id
  LEFT JOIN public.zalo_users z ON z.account_id=contact.account_id AND z.zalo_uid=contact.uid
      AND z.staff_id=contact.staff_id AND z.organization_id=contact.organization_id AND contact.flatform_type='zalo'
    LEFT JOIN public.chat_zalo_account_organization b ON b.auto_account_id=contact.account_id
      AND b.organization_id=contact.organization_id AND b.is_active AND contact.flatform_type='zalo'
    LEFT JOIN public.chat_zalo_account_user u ON u.chat_zalo_account_id=b.chat_zalo_account_id
      AND u.zalo_id=contact.uid AND contact.contact_type='person'
    LEFT JOIN public.category_item status ON status.id=u.friendship_status_category_item_id
  ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id DESC;
END;
$function$

            WHEN chat_complaint_60 = 0 THEN 'a.0'::text
            ELSE 'b.1+'::text
        END AS b_complaint60,
        CASE
            WHEN chat_fixfail_60 = 0 THEN 'a.0'::text
            ELSE 'b.1+'::text
        END AS b_fixfail60,
        CASE
            WHEN (chat_price_60 + chat_discount_60) = 0 THEN 'a.0'::text
            ELSE 'b.1+'::text
        END AS b_price60,
        CASE
            WHEN last_chat_gap IS NULL THEN 'z.none'::text
            WHEN last_chat_gap <= 7 THEN 'a.0-7'::text
            WHEN last_chat_gap <= 14 THEN 'b.8-14'::text
            WHEN last_chat_gap <= 30 THEN 'c.15-30'::text
            ELSE 'd.31+'::text
        END AS b_lastchat,
        CASE
            WHEN avg_resp_60 IS NULL THEN 'z.none'::text
            WHEN avg_resp_60 <= 300::numeric THEN 'a.<=5m'::text
            WHEN avg_resp_60 <= 1800::numeric THEN 'b.5-30m'::text
            WHEN avg_resp_60 <= 7200::numeric THEN 'c.30m-2h'::text
            ELSE 'd.2h+'::text
        END AS b_resp,
        CASE
            WHEN avg_rel_60 IS NULL THEN 'z.none'::text
            WHEN avg_rel_60 < 5::numeric THEN 'a.<5'::text
            WHEN avg_rel_60 < 7::numeric THEN 'b.5-7'::text
            WHEN avg_rel_60 < 8.5 THEN 'c.7-8.5'::text
            ELSE 'd.8.5+'::text
        END AS b_rel,
        CASE
            WHEN crm_exp_pm15 = 0 THEN 'a.0'::text
            WHEN crm_exp_pm15 = 1 THEN 'b.1'::text
            ELSE 'c.2+'::text
        END AS b_crm,
        CASE
            WHEN crm_exp_first_offset IS NULL THEN 'z.none'::text
            WHEN crm_exp_first_offset < '-7'::integer THEN 'a.<-7'::text
            WHEN crm_exp_first_offset < 0 THEN 'b.-7..-1'::text
            WHEN crm_exp_first_offset <= 3 THEN 'c.0..3'::text
            WHEN crm_exp_first_offset <= 10 THEN 'd.4..10'::text
            ELSE 'e.11+'::text
        END AS b_crmoffset,
        CASE
            WHEN is_referred THEN 'b.yes'::text
            ELSE 'a.no'::text
        END AS b_referred,
        CASE
            WHEN lead_age_days IS NULL THEN 'z.none'::text
            WHEN lead_age_days <= 7 THEN 'a.0-7'::text
            WHEN lead_age_days <= 30 THEN 'b.8-30'::text
            WHEN lead_age_days <= 180 THEN 'c.31-180'::text
            ELSE 'd.181+'::text
        END AS b_leadage,
        CASE
            WHEN first_login_gap IS NULL THEN 'z.none'::text
            WHEN first_login_gap <= 1 THEN 'a.0-1'::text
            WHEN first_login_gap <= 7 THEN 'b.2-7'::text
            ELSE 'c.8+'::text
        END AS b_firstlogin,
        CASE
            WHEN first_camp_gap IS NULL THEN 'z.none'::text
            WHEN first_camp_gap <= 1 THEN 'a.0-1'::text
            WHEN first_camp_gap <= 7 THEN 'b.2-7'::text
            WHEN first_camp_gap <= 21 THEN 'c.8-21'::text
            ELSE 'd.22+'::text
        END AS b_firstcamp,
        CASE
            WHEN login_days_post30 = 0 THEN 'a.0'::text
            WHEN login_days_post30 <= 3 THEN 'b.1-3'::text
            ELSE 'c.4+'::text
        END AS b_loginpost,
        CASE
            WHEN chat_post30 = 0 THEN 'a.0'::text
            WHEN chat_post30 <= 2 THEN 'b.1-2'::text
            ELSE 'c.3+'::text
        END AS b_chatpost,
        CASE
            WHEN n_actions_60 = 0 THEN 'a.0'::text
            WHEN n_actions_60 = 1 THEN 'b.1'::text
            WHEN n_actions_60 = 2 THEN 'c.2'::text
            ELSE 'd.3+'::text
        END AS b_actions,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(max_zalo, 0) <= 1 THEN 'a.<=1'::text
            WHEN max_zalo <= 3 THEN 'b.2-3'::text
            ELSE 'c.4+'::text
        END AS b_maxzalo,
        CASE
            WHEN has_email THEN 'b.yes'::text
            ELSE 'a.no'::text
        END AS b_email
   FROM _rn_feat_20260829 f;

relations.name: v_trial_cham_14ngay
relations.view:
WITH trial_raw AS (
         SELECT o.customer_id,
            o.date_create AS trial_at,
            'old'::text AS he_thong,
            o.id AS ref_id,
            o.account_id_old,
            NULL::bigint AS organization_id,
            o.product_list AS san_pham_goc,
            o.username AS tai_khoan,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.product_list ~~* '%sms%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%zalo%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%facebook%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%fb%'::text THEN 'SMS'::text
                    WHEN o.product_list ~~* '%zalo%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%facebook%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%fb%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%fanpage%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%sms%'::text THEN 'Zalo'::text
                    WHEN (o.product_list ~~* '%facebook%'::text OR o.product_list ~~* '%fbextension%'::text OR o.product_list ~~* '%fanpage%'::text) AND o.product_list !~~* '%zalo%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%sms%'::text THEN 'Facebook'::text
                    ELSE 'Combo'::text
                END AS nhom
           FROM aka_order o
          WHERE o.package = 'demo'::text AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND o.date_create >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date - 15)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT g.customer_id,
            q.created_at,
            'new'::text,
            q.id,
            NULL::integer,
            q.organization_id,
            q.product_name,
            g.sql_account_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN q.product_name ~~* '%facebook%'::text OR q.product_name ~~* '%fanpage%'::text THEN 'Facebook'::text
                    WHEN q.product_name ~~* '%zalo%'::text THEN 'Zalo'::text
                    WHEN q.product_name ~~* '%sms%'::text THEN 'SMS'::text
                    ELSE 'Combo'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM org_organization_product q
             JOIN org_organization g ON g.id = q.organization_id
          WHERE q.package_type = 'demo'::text AND COALESCE(q.is_deleted, false) = false AND NOT COALESCE(q.is_paid, false) AND g.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND q.created_at >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date - 15)
        ), trial AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (trial_raw.customer_id, trial_raw.nhom) trial_raw.customer_id,
            trial_raw.trial_at,
            trial_raw.he_thong,
            trial_raw.ref_id,
            trial_raw.account_id_old,
            trial_raw.organization_id,
            trial_raw.san_pham_goc,
            trial_raw.tai_khoan,
            trial_raw.nhom
           FROM trial_raw
          ORDER BY trial_raw.customer_id, trial_raw.nhom, trial_raw.trial_at
        ), base AS (
         SELECT t.customer_id,
            t.trial_at,
            t.he_thong,
            t.ref_id,
            t.account_id_old,
            t.organization_id,
            t.san_pham_goc,
            t.tai_khoan,
            t.nhom,
            a.name AS ten_khach,
            a.phone,
            NULLIF(a.email, ''::text) AS email,
            a.org_staff_id_owner,
            a.inbox_url,
            a.linh_vuc,
            (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date - (t.trial_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date AS ngay_thu,
            fn_trang_thai_mua(t.customer_id) AS trang_thai_mua,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM aka_sale_order s
                     JOIN aka_sale_order_item i ON i.sale_order_id = s.id
                  WHERE s.customer_id = t.customer_id AND s.status = 'completed'::text AND s.paid_at >= (t.trial_at - '01:00:00'::interval))) AS da_co_don,
            a.decline_date IS NOT NULL AND a.decline_date >= t.trial_at AS da_tu_choi,
                CASE
                    WHEN t.he_thong = 'old'::text THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM aka_tracking_app k
                      WHERE k.account_id = t.account_id_old AND (k.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['login'::text, 'login_app_akabiz'::text, 'open_app_akabiz'::text]))))
                    ELSE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM auto_accounts x
                      WHERE x.organization_id = t.organization_id AND COALESCE(x.is_delete, false) = false))
                END AS da_dang_nhap,
                CASE
                    WHEN t.he_thong = 'old'::text THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM aka_tracking_app k
                      WHERE k.account_id = t.account_id_old AND k.event_type = 'add'::text))
                    ELSE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM auto_campaigns k
                      WHERE k.organization_id = t.organization_id AND k.created_at >= (t.trial_at - '01:00:00'::interval)))
                END AS da_chay_chien_dich,
                CASE
                    WHEN t.he_thong = 'old'::text THEN ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                       FROM aka_tracking_app k
                      WHERE k.account_id = t.account_id_old AND k.event_type = 'add'::text)
                    ELSE ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                       FROM auto_campaigns k
                      WHERE k.organization_id = t.organization_id AND k.created_at >= (t.trial_at - '01:00:00'::interval))
                END AS so_chien_dich,
            ( SELECT max(g.question_first_at) AS max
                   FROM message_gom g
                  WHERE g.aka_customer_id = t.customer_id AND g.initiated_by = 'CUSTOMER'::text AND COALESCE(g.question_content, ''::text) <> ''::text) AS tin_khach_cuoi
           FROM trial t
             JOIN aka_customer a ON a.id = t.customer_id
        )
 SELECT customer_id,
    ten_khach,
    phone,
    email,
    nhom,
    he_thong,
    ref_id,
    organization_id,
    tai_khoan,
    san_pham_goc,
    trial_at,
    ngay_thu,
        CASE
            WHEN ngay_thu = ANY (ARRAY[1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 14]) THEN ngay_thu
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS moc,
        CASE
            WHEN da_chay_chien_dich THEN 'A'::text
            WHEN da_dang_nhap THEN 'B'::text
            ELSE 'C'::text
        END AS nhanh,
    trang_thai_mua,
    da_co_don,
    da_tu_choi,
    da_dang_nhap,
    da_chay_chien_dich,
    so_chien_dich,
    tin_khach_cuoi,
    trang_thai_mua <> 'dang_dung'::text AND NOT da_co_don AND NOT da_tu_choi AS du_dieu_kien,
    tin_khach_cuoi IS NULL OR tin_khach_cuoi < (now() - '48:00:00'::interval) AS khach_im_lang_48h,
    ngay_thu >= 5 AND (tin_khach_cuoi IS NULL OR tin_khach_cuoi < (now() - '48:00:00'::interval)) AS gui_tu_dong,
    org_staff_id_owner,
    inbox_url,
    linh_vuc
   FROM base;

relations.name: v_bot_intent_router
relations.view:
SELECT (ai_evaluated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date AS ngay,
    count(*) AS tong,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (ai_raw_response ->> '_router'::text) = 'jev'::text) AS qua_jev,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (ai_raw_response ->> '_router'::text) = 'llm'::text) AS qua_llm,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (ai_raw_response ->> '_router'::text) = 'jev'::text)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 1) AS pct_jev,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((ai_raw_response -> '_jev'::text) ->> 'error'::text) IS NOT NULL) AS jev_loi,
    percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((((ai_raw_response -> '_jev'::text) ->> 'ms'::text)::numeric)::double precision)) AS jev_p50_ms,
    round(sum(((ai_raw_response -> '_jev'::text) ->> 'cost'::text)::numeric), 4) AS jev_chi_phi_usd,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (ai_raw_response ->> '_router'::text) = 'llm'::text AND (ai_raw_response ->> '_model_used'::text) = 'deepseek-flash'::text) AS llm_deepseek,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (ai_raw_response ->> '_router'::text) = 'llm'::text AND (ai_raw_response ->> '_model_used'::text) ~~ 'gpt%'::text) AS llm_gpt
   FROM message_gom
  WHERE ai_raw_response ? '_router'::text
  GROUP BY ((ai_evaluated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date);

relations.name: v_phone_nudge_daily
relations.view:
SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text))::date AS ngay,
    account_id,
    source,
    count(*) AS job,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SENT'::text) AS da_gui,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SKIPPED'::text) AS bo_qua,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'::text) AS het_han,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED'::text) AS loi,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::text, 'CLAIMED'::text])) AS dang_cho,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip_reason ~~ 'PANCAKE_%'::text) AS pancake_chan,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip_reason = 'NOT_PROSPECT'::text) AS khong_phai_khach,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip_reason = 'SPAM'::text) AS spam,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip_reason = 'SUPPORT_ONLY'::text) AS chi_ho_tro,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip_reason = 'STAFF_ASKED'::text) AS nv_da_xin,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip_reason = 'CUSTOMER_GAVE_PHONE'::text) AS khach_da_cho,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip_reason = 'LOW_CONFIDENCE'::text) AS khong_chac,
    round(avg(EXTRACT(epoch FROM sent_at - due_at)) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SENT'::text)) AS tre_trung_binh_giay
   FROM aka_phone_nudge_job
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('day'::text, (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text))::date), account_id, source
  ORDER BY (date_trunc('day'::text, (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text))::date) DESC;
